title: Factory Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protecting in the building sector and motor vehicle industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 101 countries around the world and manufactures in over 300 factories. Its more than 27,500 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11\.20 billion in 2025\.

 **Job Description** **Title :** Factory Manager

**Department :** Operations

**Location :** Bagru, Jaipur

**Reports To :** Lead Manufacturing Cluster North \& Toll

***Overview***


To be responsible for leading operations of our factory at Bagru Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Growth, legal compliances, capacity enhancement and maintenance.

***Roles and Responsibilities****:*


1\.Manufacturing quality products as per schedule.


2\.Delivery of goods as per time scheduled by the customer.


3\. Maintain standards of 5S and Housekeeping throughout the factory.


4\.Complete compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements and ensure effective relation building with Government officers / departments.


5\. Maintain EHS, ISO\-9001:2000 and other related quality systems as per existing norms. Fully compliance with Pollution control norms and well aware about pollution norms, ETP, STP and water treatment.


6\.Inspire leadership, maintain positive discipline and foster harmonious industrial relations among management, staff and workmen.


7\.Recruit, train and retain a strong team for successful unit operation.


8\.Reduce unit overhead cost through Direct Labour, expenses, Productivity, effective process flow etc. Managing factory Budget and ensure monthly reporting the same.


9\. Cycle counts and physical verification process and take factory inventory visibility to organization.


10\. Good understanding of equipment, engineering process, productivity KPI and projects for running a sizable formulation plant.

 **INTER\-DEPARTMENTAL RELATIONSHIPS:**


Internal : Please include QC, Technology, EHS, projects, Supply Chain Management dept.


External : Please include vendors, service providers (labour, logistics...etc.) for Bagru factory,

 **KEY SKILLS REQUIRED**

* Good Chemical process knowledge of Construction Chemical, paint industry, powder and liquid blending through HMI and SCADA process automation.
* Good knowledge on packing machines of powder lines, liquid and viscous products.
* Good supervisory skills with capability of handling Company employees and contractors.
* Experience of retail, distribution and direct business product manufacturing exposure. Handling 300\+ finish goods SKUs and more than 1000 RM/PM exposure is desired.
* Problem solving and analytical abilities. Solution provider and positive attitude.
* Good English written and oral Communication. Good inter personnel skills and the ability to inspire and build a strong team.
* Good Coach and mentor.
* Integrity and honesty and able to foster it in team.
* Good production planning capability along with hands on experience with shift management. Handling Production activities, bringing improvements in Productivity and providing guidance to the manufacturing unit in production planning, Inventory Control, excellent managerial abilities.
* Resource organizing and networking capability.
* Hands on financial and factory cost understanding
* Hands on experience on SAP production module
* Basic knowledge of HR / IR requirements or experience
* Basic shopfloor safety knowledge \& experience
* Eye for operation excellence

 **Qualifications \& Experience:**


 BE/BTech: Chemical or Mechanical. 10 to 14 years exp in Manufacturing.

 **Qualifications**  

 BE/BTech: Chemical or Mechanical.

 **Additional Information**  

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Machine Learning Senior Analyst - HIH - Evernorth
description:
**INTRODUCTION TO EVERNORTH:**


Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The innovation hub will support innovation\-focused areas, such as generative AI, product development, process improvement, analytics, and software engineering across The Cigna Group and its businesses. Evernorth Health Services India builds on The Cigna Group’s existing presence in India.

**About Evernorth Health Services:**


Evernorth Health Services (Evernorth) is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group \- a Fortune 16 global health company with 75,000 employees, 186 million customers in more than 30 countries and jurisdictions around the world. Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.

**About Cigna:**


The Cigna Group is a global health company committed to improving the health and vitality of individuals and communities around the world and includes products and services marketed under its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services subsidiaries. Cigna Healthcare is the health benefits provider of The Cigna Group, serving customers and clients through its U.S. Employer, U.S. Government, and International Health business. Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group.


Cigna, a leading Health Services company, is looking for an exceptional Back end and API engineer in our Provider Engineering organization. This position is responsible for the delivery of a business need starting from understanding the requirements to deploying the software into production. This role requires you to be fluent in some of the critical technologies with proficiency in others, with a very strong analytical aptitude and have a hunger to learn on the job, understand data and add value to the business. Critical attributes of being a Back End Engineer, among others, is ownership, eagerness to learn \& an open mindset. In addition to delivery, the role demands having an automation first and continuous improvement mindset. The candidate should drive the adoption of CI/CD tools and support the improvement of the tools sets/processes. improvement of the tools sets/processes.

**Position Overview**


Are you looking for an opportunity to engineer modern application, Continuous Deployment/Continuous Integration, and embedded solutions(UI/API \& LLM) across a breadth of core platforms and technologies and foster a community while being supported with plentiful training and mentorship opportunities?


We’re looking for a Software Engineering Analyst who will be responsible to accelerate us on embedded solution(UI/API \& LLM) journey. The journey requires building foundational capabilities/patterns and enabling teams from a design, technical architecture and selecting LLM/cloud services wisely. This role requires proved technology excellence with strong hands\-on digital experience.


We are seeking a skilled and passionate Agentic AI Developer with 3–6 years of experience to join our team. This role is ideal for professionals who bring a fresh foundation in full stack development and have evolved into AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI domains. You will be instrumental in developing and deploying intelligent systems that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic architectures to solve complex business problems.

**Responsibilities**

* Gathers and analyzes test software requirements for various applications within the organization.
* Understands a program’s architecture/design, logical and physical data models.
* Design and Develop applications built in Python/C\#
* Good exposure on AI Concepts/Models (LLM)
* Support other product delivery partners in the successful build, test, and release of solutions
* Ability to work on projects independently with minimal or no oversight required.
* Examine and discover methods to improve the accuracy, effectiveness, and dependability of data quality and support.
* Support the full software lifecycle of design, development, testing, and support for technical delivery
* Works with both (Scrum Master, Product, QA and Developers) and QA team members in properly defining testable scenarios based on requirements/acceptance criteria.
* Be part of a fast\-moving team, working with the latest tools and open\-source technologies
* Work on a development team using agile methodologies.
* Understand the Business and the Application Architecture End to End
* Solve problems by crafting software solutions using maintainable and modular code
* Participate in daily team standup meetings where you'll give and receive updates on the current backlog and challenges.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Computer Science or Engineering or related course work
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in programming, API development and UI development. We need a very clear understanding \& be able to explain how would we develop sample cases.
* Basic hands on experience working in database environments like, Oracle, SQL, MongoDB etc
* Basic exposure in using IDE like Visual Studio Code, VS Code Etc
* Good hands on experience in Python, C\#. We need some passionate young developers to work on key initiatives which are aimed at accuracy \& efficiency.
* Design, fine\-tune, and deploy LLMs for enterprise use cases.
* Integrate LLMs with legacy systems and modern cloud\-native applications.
* Develop and optimize ML models for classification, prediction, and recommendation tasks.
* Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize models in production environments.
* Contribute to front\-end and back\-end development using Vue.js, Node.js, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Work with AWS services for scalable deployment of AI/ML solutions.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with advancements in GenAI, agentic frameworks, and cloud\-native AI tooling.

**Required Experience \& Education:**

* Proven hands on experience with design, and development of large\-scale enterprise application solutions.
* College degree (Bachelor) in related technical/business areas or equivalent work experience.
* Beginner level experience in relational and NOSQL databases
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in Software engineering
* Should be flexible in working with freshers and help them guide through the programme while they learn from senior resources in project.
* Hands on experience in developing applications in Python, C\# and machine learning concepts.
* Willing to learn, go above and beyond attitudes.
* Experience with modern and legacy development languages.

**Location \& Hours of Work**

* Full\-time position, working 40 hours per week. Expected overlap with US hours as appropriate
* Primarily based in the Innovation Hub in Hyderabad, India in a hybrid working model (3 days WFO and 2 days WAH)

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

**About Evernorth Health Services**


Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Front End Developer
description:
**About the Opportunity**

Frontend is not a support function at Gracia. It is central to how we design and ship products, and we are scaling that capability.

We are looking for a **UI/UX \& Frontend Developer – Figma, React, Flutter \& Full Stack** who can take a product idea, design it in Figma, and then build it into a production\-grade web or mobile application without hand\-holding at any stage. This is an end\-to\-end ownership role. You will design the interface, translate it into working code, integrate it with backend systems, and ship features that actually work, not just visually but functionally, for the business using them.

If you can design a clean, usable interface in Figma and then build it yourself in React and Flutter and want to grow inside a firm building real fintech products alongside its consulting practice, this role is for you.

**What You Will Do**

*UI/UX Design in Figma*  
Design wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI screens in Figma for web and mobile applications. Own the design process from concept to design system, layouts, components, spacing, states, and interactions, before a single line of code is written.

*Figma\-to\-Code Implementation*  
Convert your own (or existing) Figma UI designs into pixel\-accurate, responsive React (web) and Flutter (mobile) code. You own the full translation from design to functioning interface.

*Full Stack Web Application Development*  
Build and maintain web applications end\-to\-end, frontend components, API integration, state management, and where needed, backend/API work to support the features you're building.

*Cross\-Platform Mobile Development*  
Develop and maintain Flutter applications for iOS and Android from a single codebase, ensuring consistent behaviour and performance across platforms.

*Design System \& Component Architecture*  
Build and maintain a reusable design system in Figma, and mirror it in code through reusable, maintainable component libraries, so new screens and features can be designed and built faster without duplicating work.

*API Integration \& Data Flow*  
Integrate frontend applications with REST/GraphQL APIs, third\-party services, and internal systems (including Zoho and FinBowl/PEMS). Understand how data moves through the application, not just how to display it.

*Performance \& Quality*  
Optimise for load time, responsiveness, and smooth interactions. Write code that is testable, debuggable, and doesn't break under real\-world use.

*Collaboration with Product \& Stakeholders*  
Work closely with product owners and, where relevant, clients, to understand what's needed, design it, validate it, and then build it, closing the loop yourself instead of handing off between design and dev.

*Deployment \& Handover*  
Ship features to production, document your work, and ensure both the Figma files and codebase remain understandable and maintainable for whoever touches them next.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong working knowledge of **Figma** — wireframing, prototyping, component\-based design systems, and handoff\-ready files.
* Strong working knowledge of **React** (hooks, state management, component design) and **Flutter/Dart** for cross\-platform mobile development.
* Proven ability to take a product requirement, design it in Figma, and then build it into responsive, accurate frontend code, end to end, without significant rework.
* Full stack comfort — you can work with APIs, basic backend logic, and databases, even if your primary strength is frontend and design.
* Understanding of **REST/GraphQL APIs**, authentication flows, and state management patterns (Redux, Zustand, Riverpod, Provider, or similar).
* Strong eye for **UI/UX fundamentals** — visual hierarchy, spacing, usability, and consistent interaction patterns.
* Automation and tooling mindset — comfortable with Git, CI/CD basics, and writing code that scales beyond a single feature.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll work directly with product owners, and occasionally clients.
* Experience with mobile app store deployment (Play Store/App Store) is a plus.
* Prior experience designing and building fintech, CRM, or ERP\-adjacent applications is a strong advantage.

**Who Should Apply**

Candidates with **1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience** in UI/UX design (Figma) combined with React and Flutter development. Freshers with an exceptional portfolio (Figma designs paired with shipped code) and strong communication skills will also be considered. Must be based in Mumbai or willing to relocate.

**Location:** Mumbai, India  
**Role Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1 to 3 years (exceptional freshers welcome)

Gracia Global Advisory LLP is an ISO 9001:2015\-certified firm, a Zoho Finance Advanced Partner, and a member of the World Trade Center Mumbai and the Indo\-American Chamber of Commerce.

Jain Soap \& Jain Lifecare Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a proactive and experienced **Sr. HR Executive** to manage core HR operations and support the organization's people strategy. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in recruitment, HR operations, employee lifecycle management, attendance and leave administration, HRMS, and office administration. **Job description**

As the Instruction Specialist , you would be responsible for facilitating Pi Labs at partner government and affordable private schools to create a high\-quality computer science education ecosystem for student learning. **Roles \& Responsibilities:**  
As an Instruction Specialist, you will support all current and future educational initiatives and programs. Your portfolio will include:  
● Program Delivery  
○ Ensure optimum instructional delivery of Curriculum across the specified grades in assigned school(s). This will involve teaching (\& travel) in classrooms spread across the city/ district.

and membership in the profession

○ Conduct hackathons, quizzes, and field visits for students to increase interest and provide learning experiences.  
○ Support Team in basic operational and program/event requirements for the annual event(s).

Contribute to the development and growth of the organisation services and support for out\-of\-classroom programs, workshops, additional R\&D activities for program/curriculum testing, the impact and analysis process, recruitment and performance appraisals and team\-wide decision making.

**Required Qualifications:**  
Each core responsibility outlined above needs specific skills to fulfill. While many of these will be developed and honed through the role, some of the following are skills and mindsets we would like you to bring with you to the role and organization:  
● Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree from an accredited university or equivalent experience

● Have relationship management skills and the ability to build rapport with stakeholders  
● Be an intellectually curious and responsive team contributor, delivering and receiving feedback regularly, and eager to learn and stay up to date on computer science education.

Compliance

* Ensure accurate deduction and payment of TDS wherever applicable.
* Maintain supporting documents for statutory and internal audits.
* Comply with company financial policies and accounting standards.

MIS \& Reporting

* Generate ageing analysis of creditors.
* Assist in monthly and year\-end closing activities.
* Provide payment forecasts and cash flow requirements to management.

Internal Controls

* Ensure adherence to internal financial controls.
* Maintain proper documentation for all transactions.
* Support internal, statutory, and tax audits.
* Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and controls.

title: Human Resource Intern
description:
Job Title: HR Management Intern (High\-Exposure / Multi\-Industry)

About Us

Keystone Collective is not your traditional corporate HR department. We are a dynamic HR outsourcing firm, which means we act as the strategic HR engine for a diverse portfolio of companies across completely different industry segments. For a budding HR professional, this means you don't just learn how one company works—you learn how the entire business ecosystem operates.

The Reality Check

**If you think HR is just an "easy, people\-oriented job" with standard 9\-to\-5 routines, this role is not for you.**

We are looking for a sharp, high\-energy, and genuinely passionate individual. You will be tossed into the deep end of end\-to\-end HR operations across multiple sectors simultaneously. The learning curve is steep, the pace is fast, but the professional exposure is unmatched.

Key Responsibilities

You won't be stuck doing coffee runs or just filing papers. You will actively manage and execute end\-to\-end HR activities, including:

* **Multi\-Industry Recruitment:** Sourcing, screening, and onboarding talent for completely different sectors, adapting your strategy to each industry's unique demands.
* **Operations \& Compliance:** Assisting with payroll inputs, employee documentation, and ensuring compliance across various client frameworks.
* **Client Coordination:** Acting as a bridge between Keystone Collective and our client partners to understand and execute their specific HR needs.
* **Employee Engagement \& Relations:** Designing and implementing engagement initiatives tailored to diverse organizational cultures.

Who You Are

* **Genuinely Passionate:** You see HR as a core business driver, not a soft administrative function.
* **Intellectually Sharp:** You can jump from an IT client's requirements to a manufacturing client's needs without missing a beat.
* **Resilient \& Adaptive:** You thrive under pressure and view ambiguity as an opportunity to figure things out.
* **Excellent Communicator:** You possess top\-tier verbal and written communication skills to interface confidently with various stakeholders.

What’s in It for You?

* **Exponential Growth:** Gain 1–2 years worth of diverse organizational experience packed into a single internship.
* **True End\-to\-End Exposure:** Master everything from recruitment to offboarding across multiple industries.
* **Mentorship:** Work directly under industry experts who will push you to your highest potential.
* **Certificate \& Letter of Recommendation** (with potential for a full\-time role based on stellar performance).

Pay: From ₹5,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kaladi, Kerala

description:

description:
**About Axience:** 




**Introduction:** 



* Axience is a professional business services firm, established with the credo of delivering “Integrated Bespoke Solutions” for our clients
* We provide high\-quality bespoke and boutique\-style financial and business research services and have established ourselves as a well\-regarded research firm with a strong clientele, board, and management team
* Our offices are located in Mumbai, India and the UAE, with extended sales and execution capabilities
* At Axience, we carefully hire at the fresher and experienced levels and develop our team even more carefully
* Hiring and Personnel development are both continuous, ongoing processes and so we are looking for a Human Resources Manager who will oversee both in a structured manner
* We offer competitive financial rewards, rapid learning and growth, and significant and varied responsibility to exceptionally driven and motivated candidates. We provide an intellectually stimulating and empowering work environment and place a high emphasis on being an equal opportunity employer



  





**The Role:** 




**Associate / Sr Associate \- HR and Business Management** 




**Roles and Responsibilities:** 




  





**Human Resources Policy Development and Implementation** 



* Review, challenge and redesign all human resources and related policies/guidelines/documents – both existing and absent ones
* Update policies based on each instance/event/question in a professional manner and communicate
* Maintain world\-class standards while doing so



  





**Employee Development and Employer Branding** 



* Implement management vision by driving and implementing a world\-class (yet suitable to the firm and instance) first call to offer recruitment cycle
* Conduct HR meetings with employees on a regular basis and draw inferences for the long\-term development of staff
* Maintain per employee trackers to measure their performance, career development plan and associated appraisals and training/ upgradation schedules



  





**Recruitment** 



* Conduct high\-energy, research\-driven recruitment based on competition/market/industry knowledge and define/implement exceptional processes
* Ability to run targeted time\-bound recruitment drives to fill specific positions and fresh graduate (batch\-based recruitment)
* Ability to represent the organisation in talks at Universities and in outreach with educational institutes
* Data\-driven and process\-driven approach emphasising testing, background verification and band\-based compensation benchmarking



  





**Employee Suggestions and Grievances** 



* Handle all employee grievances and suggestions with a 360\-degree view and with long\-term policy design and its impact in mind



  





**Employer Branding** 



* Initiate policies, processes, actions, and events to increase the popularity of the brand
* Create successful ex\-employee case studies
* Liaise with team leaders and managers, introduce specific HR initiatives and recommend HR solutions aligned to business objectives and strategy
* Improve organisational design and structure, support change leadership and management coaching
* Be responsible for Talent Management, Performance Management, Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Staffing, Succession Planning, Organisation Structure, and Skills Assessments



  





**﻿Administration and Business Management** 



* Optional responsibilities based on the profile of the candidate; ie a senior\-level HR professional with desirous of having business management responsibility would have significant business/office/administration management responsibilities



  





**Academic and professional background:** 



* Master / Graduates from top\-tier institutions and degrees renowned in HR/Administration for
* Strong academic background and aptitude with consistent performance at all levels/, record of extra\-curricular achievements
* Experience from tier 1 companies and institutions
* SHRM and other certifications are desired



  
 



**Required skills:** 



* Ability to think like a manager/business mind and not simply like a recruiter/HR process executor
* Exceptional personality combining an aura and humility
* General exposure and wisdom



  





**Contact** 




 If you have the qualification, experience, and passion for the role mentioned above, please send your CV and Cover Letter to hr.openings@axience.com.
 



  





**Other Requirements** 



* Only Mumbai based candidates or those who are willing to relocate to Mumbai will be considered
* Willing to work from the office 5 days a week. The office location is Andheri East, Mumbai
* Strong Academic grades and International travel experience are preferred

**About Us**

Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. title: Junior Equity Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Junior Equity Analyst** 

**Job Purpose:**

Are you passionate about the stock market and eager to dive into the world of equity analysis? Join our dynamic team as a Junior Equity Analyst and embark on a journey of hands\-on training and growth within the exciting realm of global market trading. You will gain invaluable experience analyzing the US markets, learning the intricacies of stock trading, and preparing yourself to make informed, data\-driven trading decisions that could shape your career.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Master Technical Analysis**: Learn how to perform cutting\-edge technical analysis on major US stock exchanges including NYSE, NASDAQ, and Amex, unlocking the power to predict market movements.
* **Evaluate Securities:** Gain expertise in assessing the performance and pricing of US listed companies, using advanced tools and techniques to uncover trends and opportunities.
* **Forecast Market Trends:** Develop your skills in forecasting stock performance and creating actionable projections based on thorough research and analysis.
* **Stay Ahead of the Curve:** Keep a close eye on industry trends, market news, and global events that impact stock prices and market behavior.
* **Create Impactful Reports:** Hone your ability to craft well\-informed, data\-backed reports that evaluate company fundamentals, historical performance, and potential future outcomes.
* **Career Growth**: Upon successful completion of the program, transition into a full fledged US Equity Analyst/Trader, where you’ll make key decisions in the US stock market, influencing the organization’s trading strategy.

**Qualifications:** 

* **Educational Background:** A degree in Finance (e.g., B. Com, BBA, MBA, PGDM) or certifications such as NCFM, CFA, or CMT. Passion for finance and trading is a must!
* **Age Range:** Open to individuals between 20\-24 years of age, ready to kick\-start their career in equity analysis.
* **Fresh Mindset:** Open to freshers or those looking to pivot into the world of stock market analysis and trading.
* **Not a Recent Applicant:** Candidates who have participated in the selection process within the last 6 months are not eligible.

**Work Timings \& Location:**

* **Work Hours:** 06:00 PM to 03:00 AM, Monday to Friday—ideal for those who enjoy aligning their workday with global financial markets and US trading hours.
* **Location: Eon IT Park, Kharadi, Pune.** Work in a modern, vibrant environment that fosters growth and innovation.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Skill Development:** Receive comprehensive, hands\-on training with the potential to grow into a high\-impact **US Equity Analyst role.**
* **Career Advancement:** This position provides clear career progression with exciting opportunities for professional growth. After training, top performers will have the opportunity to advance to roles such as:

**1\. Associate US Equity Analyst** 

**2\. Equity Analyst** 

**3\. Senior Equity Analyst**

* **Incentives \& Rewards:** Enjoy a highly attractive incentive program, rewarding your hard work and achievements.
* **No Sales or Marketing:** This is a purely analytical role—no selling or marketing of financial products or services. Focus on what matters most: analyzing markets and making data\-driven decisions.

**Training Program:** 

* **Duration:** Minimum 3\-month training period (subject to progress).
* **Full\-Time, Permanent:** This is a full\-time opportunity with long\-term potential.

**Interview Process:**

**1\. HR Round:** We want to know about your background, motivations, and passion for financial markets.

**2\. Aptitude Test:** Showcase your quantitative skills and ability to analyze complex data.

**3\. Technical/Manager’s Round:** Dive deep into your knowledge of market analysis and your ability to interpret financial data and trends.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: From ₹2,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Stock market: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: AI Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Cybersecurity Analyst based in India.**
 This role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity operations and AI\-driven security automation, where human expertise is essential to validate and refine machine\-generated threat insights. You will work within a modern SOC environment powered by advanced XDR and SIEM technologies, ensuring that automated investigations are accurate, complete, and contextually relevant. The position focuses on bridging AI\-driven detection systems with real\-world security judgment to improve threat response quality. You will analyze incidents, validate findings, and ensure that security workflows execute correctly across complex digital environments. Working in a fast\-evolving cybersecurity landscape, you will contribute directly to improving detection accuracy, reducing false positives, and strengthening operational resilience. This is a highly analytical role where precision, critical thinking, and security expertise directly enhance enterprise threat defense.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Validate AI\-driven SecOps investigations by reviewing incident attack narratives, alerts, entities, and correlated security signals for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure automated investigation workflows execute correctly, identifying and reporting technical issues or inconsistencies in SOC processes.
* Confirm incident verdicts by analyzing and identifying false positives, misclassifications, or incomplete threat assessments.
* Perform deeper technical analysis when required, including file inspection, sandboxing, URL detonation, and contextual investigation using enterprise data sources.
* Review and validate incident management tags and approve, modify, or reject AI\-generated findings before escalation or response actions.
* Collaborate with security teams to refine detection logic and improve the reliability of AI\-assisted security operations.
* Support continuous improvement of Microsoft Defender XDR and Sentinel\-based detection and response workflows.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation, and operational consistency across security investigations.


**Requirements**
* Strong foundational knowledge of cybersecurity operations, incident response, and threat analysis.
* Familiarity with SIEM and XDR platforms, preferably Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Understanding of MITRE ATT\&CK framework and common attack techniques and threat behaviors.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated security findings.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies in complex security data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting and explaining incident analysis.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced SOC environments and handle multiple concurrent investigations.
* Relevant certification such as Microsoft SC\-200 is highly desirable.
* Basic understanding of security automation, SOAR concepts, or AI\-assisted SOC workflows is a plus.
* Strong curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging cybersecurity and AI technologies.


**Benefits**
* Competitive base salary with performance\-based biannual bonuses.
* Monthly allowances for health insurance, laptop usage, and internet support.
* Paid time off including up to 20 days annually plus all statutory holidays.
* Opportunities for international assignments across global locations including the USA and UAE.
* Continuous training on advanced cybersecurity tools, AI\-driven SOC technologies, and industry frameworks.
* Certification reimbursement for relevant cybersecurity qualifications and professional development.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge AI \+ XDR security operations in a high\-growth environment.

description:

title: SALES TRAINEE - IT
description:
**Job post summary**

Job Description:

IT Sales trainee

IT sales consultants are sales professionals who specialize in selling computer hardware and software, as well as IT services. Success in this industry requires advanced knowledge of fundamental IT principles. IT sales professionals have to be able to answer highly technical questions in order to close sales. As the job title suggests, IT sales professionals are employed by companies within the IT industry. This includes companies that sell hardware, such as en user computing devices, servers, storage, networking and other products related to IT infra. It also includes selling software, which can be specific to an industry, such as healthcare or finance, ERP or cloud.

As an IT sales professional, you'll usually work with commercial clients, finding the right technological hardware and software products to suit their business needs.

The work of an IT sales professional falls into three main areas:

* pre\-sales \- giving detailed information about technical specifications and the ways in which they could meet a customer's needs
* sales \- negotiating a commercial agreement to the benefit of both the customer and supplier
* post\-sales (or after\-sales) \- generate inquiries for AMCs, support services etc

Responsibilities as an IT sales professional, you'll need to:

* speak to customers, either face to face or over the phone
* gain an understanding of customers' diverse and specific business needs and apply product knowledge to meet them
* ensure quality of service by developing a thorough and detailed knowledge of technical specifications and other features of employers' systems and processes, and then documenting them
* carry out cold\-calling in order to create interest in products and services, generate new business leads and arrange meetings
* identify and develop new business through networking and follow\-up courtesy calls
* prepare and deliver presentations and demonstrations of software to customers
* market and promote a portfolio of products by writing and designing sales literature and attending industry events
* maintain awareness and keep abreast of constantly changing software and hardware systems and peripherals (e.g. keyboard and mouse)
* develop effective sales plans using sales methodology
* provide technical advice to customers on all aspects of the installation and use of computer systems and networks, both before and after the sale
* advise on software features and how they can be applied to assist in a variety of contexts such as accounting, manufacturing or other specialist areas
* network with existing customers in order to maintain links and promote additional products and upgrades
* handle hardware or software problems and faults, referring on to specialist technical colleagues where appropriate
* respond to tender documents, proposals, reports and supporting literature
* manage workload in order to organise and prioritise daily and weekly goals
* contribute to team or progress meetings to update and inform colleagues.

title: Assistant Manager – Product Marketing
description:
**Role Summary**

The Assistant Manager – Product Marketing is a field\-based leadership role responsible for driving the brand presence of Sreedhareeyam Ayurveda and Farmherbs Botanicals across retail outlets throughout Kerala. The incumbent will be the brand's on\-ground ambassador, ensuring that the company's 100% herbal, plant\-based beauty and baby care products are consistently and compellingly presented at every retail touchpoint. This role suits someone who is proactive, highly mobile, relationship\-driven, and passionate about building a category\-defining herbal brand at the retail level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Retail Brand Presentation \& Display Management**

* Plan, execute, and maintain product displays and planograms across all assigned retail stores in Kerala as per brand standards.
* Ensure prominent shelf placement, correct product sequencing, and maximum share of shelf for brand SKUs.
* Set up and maintain point\-of\-sale (POS) materials including shelf talkers, standees, posters, wobblers, and branded display units.
* Conduct regular store visits to audit display quality, stock levels, pricing accuracy, and brand visibility.
* Identify and capture opportunities for additional display space, secondary placements, and special feature areas within stores.

**2\. Retail Store Coverage \& Field Operations**

* Travel across Kerala to manage and service a defined network of retail accounts including pharmacies, health \& beauty stores, supermarkets, and general trade outlets.
* Plan and execute an efficient beat plan to ensure all assigned stores are visited at the appropriate frequency.
* Build and maintain strong on\-ground relationships with store managers, pharmacists, category buyers, and front\-line retail staff.
* Address and resolve in\-store issues including out\-of\-stocks, expiry concerns, damaged units, and incorrect pricing promptly.

**3\. Product Launch \& Campaign Execution**

* Lead in\-store execution of new product launches across retail channels.
* Implement marketing campaigns, seasonal promotions, and festive display activations aligned with brand guidelines.
* Coordinate availability and placement of launch assets, samples, and promotional materials in advance of campaign dates.
* Monitor the effectiveness of in\-store activations and report results with photographic documentation.

**4\. Stock \& Trade Management**

* Monitor stock levels across stores to prevent out\-of\-stock situations and ensure listing of all active SKUs.

 This role sits at the intersection of technical writing, structured content engineering, and automation, supporting enterprise\-scale digital content ecosystems. You will design and maintain modular, reusable technical documentation using structured authoring standards while enabling intelligent content discovery and reuse. The role involves working with modern content management platforms and contributing to a Digital Asset Management environment. You will also develop Python\-based automation solutions to streamline content workflows, validation, and integration processes. Operating in a highly collaborative and innovation\-driven setting, you will help shape AI\-ready, machine\-consumable documentation. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys combining documentation expertise with engineering and automation to improve content scalability and efficiency across global systems.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Develop and maintain structured technical content using DITA/XML and modular authoring principles such as topics, maps, and content reuse strategies.
* Transform complex technical information into clear, reusable, and well\-organized content components optimized for enterprise use.
* Manage full content lifecycle activities including versioning, publishing, updates, archival, and retirement within content platforms.
* Define and maintain metadata, taxonomy, and classification structures to enhance discoverability and governance across systems.
* Work with content management and publishing platforms (including AEM\-based environments) for structured authoring and delivery workflows.
* Build Python\-based automation scripts to optimize content processing, validation, tagging, and workflow efficiency.
* Integrate APIs and AI/LLM\-based services to support advanced content operations such as summarization, retrieval, and enrichment.
* Support content migration and ingestion activities, ensuring structural and metadata consistency across systems.
* Ensure adherence to documentation standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for scalable content ecosystems.
* Optimize content for searchability, reuse, and intelligent retrieval within digital asset management environments.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in technical writing with strong expertise in DITA, XML, and structured authoring methodologies.
* Strong proficiency in Python programming for automation, scripting, and system integration tasks.
* Hands\-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM as a Cloud Service) and related publishing workflows.
* Experience working with structured content delivery platforms and enterprise content management systems.
* Familiarity with Adobe Edge Delivery Services and modern content publishing architectures.
* Exposure to LLM APIs, AI services, or service\-based integrations for content enhancement.
* Understanding of Digital Asset Management (DAM) principles including metadata, taxonomy, and content modeling.
* Basic knowledge of retrieval concepts such as RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and cloud/SaaS\-based documentation environments.
* Nice to have: knowledge of DITA\-OT, semantic modeling, knowledge graphs, vector search, embeddings, or content quality tools (e.g., Acrolinx, Congree).
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work across technical and content\-focused teams.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Who we are**



Moniepoint is one of Africa’s fastest\-growing fintech companies, recognised by the Financial Times for three consecutive years. We provide an end\-to\-end financial ecosystem powering payments, banking, credit, and business tools for over 10 million users, processing more than $250B\+ in annual transaction value.



In 2024\-2025, Moniepoint completed a Series C fundraise exceeding $200 million, backed by leading global investors including Visa, Google’s Africa Investment Fund, Development Partners International, LeapFrog Investments, Lightrock, and IFC. This investment underscores our scale, profitability, and long\-term roadmap and solidifies Moniepoint’s position as one of Africa’s fintech unicorns.


*Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work?* *Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.*


#### **About the role**



We are hiring a Technical Recruiter with demonstrated ownership of the full hiring lifecycle and the ability to operate with clarity, structure, and consistency. This role requires a professional who is comfortable managing complex hiring pipelines, partnering with senior leaders, and recruiting for niche and high\-impact roles across engineering and supporting functions. The ideal candidate brings discipline, accountability, and an informed understanding of talent markets, particularly within technology.


#### **What you’ll get to do**


* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including requirement intake, sourcing, assessment, stakeholder alignment, offer management, and onboarding.
* Develop and execute structured sourcing strategies to engage strong talent across active and passive markets.
* Build trusted advisory relationships with hiring managers and business leaders to understand role requirements, workforce plans, and organizational priorities.
* Maintain and continuously develop a pipeline of technical and leadership candidates for current and future hiring needs.
* Collaborate with HR and business teams to streamline hiring processes, support workforce planning, and contribute to long\-term talent strategy.
* Utilize recruitment systems, reporting, and data to drive transparency, measure progress, and support process improvements.

#### **To succeed in this role, we think you should have:**


* Minimum 5 years of full\-cycle recruitment experience, preferably with exposure to high\-growth or technology\-led environments.
* Demonstrated capability in sourcing and engaging passive candidates using structured research methods and diverse talent channels.
* Proven experience hiring senior\-level engineering talent and technical leadership roles.
* Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to set clear expectations, provide structured updates, and drive alignment through delivery.
* Experience hiring across multiple functional areas, including Engineering, Product, Business, and Commercial roles.
* High degree of ownership, self\-management, and follow\-through.
* Familiarity with ATS platforms and HR systems, and ability to apply data to refine hiring decisions and workflows.
* Clear, structured approach to communication and documentation.
* Strong commercial understanding of how effective hiring supports organizational priorities and workforce growth.

#### **What we can offer you**


* **Work environment:** A culture grounded in respect, accountability, and support. We value clarity, fairness, and consistent delivery.
* **Development:** Opportunities for professional growth through structured learning, knowledge\-sharing, and access to subject\-matter expertise.
* **Compensation:** Competitive salary, performance\-based annual bonus, pension, health insurance, and additional benefits.

#### **What to expect in the hiring process**


* A technical interview with the talent acquisition team
* A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the TA leadership team.

#### **How to Apply**



Please submit your CV or LinkedIn profile through our careers platform. All applications will be reviewed, and candidates whose profiles meet the requirements will be contacted.


#### Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Senior Human Resources Specialist
description:
**About Company** 




  





 Company is a fast\-growing startup building a tech\-enabled platform in the sustainability and waste management space. It helps individuals and businesses sell scrap materials—like paper, plastic, metal, and electronics—through a simple and reliable doorstep pickup service.
 



 By bringing structure to a traditionally unorganized sector, the company is creating both economic and environmental impact. It operates across multiple Indian cities and is backed by strong investors.
 



 The founding team comes with solid experience in technology and operations, and the company is steadily scaling its reach and impact.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are hiring
 **Senior Human Resources Manager** 
 , a pivotal role responsible for building our HR processes and team from the ground up. You will lead all HR verticals with a primary focus on
 **Talent Acquisition** 
 ,
 **Performance Management** 
 , and
 **Payroll (including Blue\-Collar Employee Operations)** 
 . This is a hands\-on, strategic role with tremendous opportunity to shape culture, scale hiring, and implement HR best practices tailored to a high\-growth, impact\-driven startup.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with leadership and department heads to forecast and fulfill hiring needs across tech, operations, and blue\-collar teams.
* Lead the full\-cycle recruitment process: JD creation, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and onboarding.
* Build a strong talent pipeline across white\- and blue\-collar roles.
* Set up and optimize recruitment platforms and vendor partnerships.



  





**2\. Performance Management \& Employee Development** 



* Design and implement OKR\-driven performance review systems.
* Partner with team leads to define career paths, development plans, and skill\-building roadmaps.
* Lead feedback cycles, one\-on\-one frameworks, and coaching mechanisms to ensure continuous growth.
* Establish recognition and rewards programs aligned with company values.



  





**3\. Payroll, Compliance \& HR Operations** 



* Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely disbursement for all employee categories.
* Handle blue\-collar workforce compliance including wage structures, ESI, PF, gratuity, and labour law adherence.
* Maintain HRMS and accurate employee records (contracts, leaves, attendance, etc.).
* Support internal and statutory audits and manage all reporting needs.



  





**4\. Culture, Engagement \& Retention** 



* Be a cultural custodian—drive employee engagement, wellness programs, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Be the go\-to person for grievance handling, conflict resolution, and team morale.
* Lead communication, team events, and internal branding efforts to foster inclusion and belonging.



  





**5\. Generalist Hustle \& Strategic Partnership** 



* Take ownership of office operations, vendor management, and internal workflows.
* Support leadership with strategic people insights to drive organizational scaling.
* Be hands\-on, self\-driven, and ready to experiment in a high\-energy startup setup.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in HR Generalist or Business Partner roles.
* Strong experience in Talent Acquisition, Performance Management, Payroll, and Blue\-Collar HR Operations.
* Prior experience in a startup or fast\-scaling environment is highly preferred.
* Sound knowledge of Indian labor laws, wage regulations, and HR compliance norms.
* Excellent people skills—empathetic, proactive, and solution\-oriented.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and communication abilities.
* A builder mindset—comfortable wearing multiple hats and thriving in ambiguity.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Be the founding HR member and shape the future of people and culture.
* Drive impact in a sector with real environmental and social change.
* Work alongside a visionary leadership team in a high\-ownership environment.



  





 If you're someone who believes in people\-first workplaces and loves to build HR systems from the ground up—let’s connect!

**What is Findem:**

  

Findem is HR 2\.0\. We’re a fast\-growth startup with an ambitious vision and the technology to back it up. Our People Intelligence platform uses true AI and machine learning to provide critical solutions for talent acquisition and people analytics functions. With the deep insights that our platform provides, companies can build more engaged and diverse teams, and close their talent gaps faster. We have an amazing opportunity to establish ourselves as leaders in this space, and we need strong advocates to help us achieve that goal.  

We’re backed by top\-tier investors including Wing Venture Capital – the same firm that backed Snowflake, Cohesity, and Gong. Findem powers businesses across scaling, pre\-IPO, and publicly traded companies who trust us to solve their biggest HR and Talent challenges. We have an incredibly skilled and collaborative team that values curiosity, diversity, openness and building great experiences every day for our customers. By joining Findem, you will have the unique opportunity to help define what the future of HR looks like for every business.

  

**Job Description:**

  

We are hiring an Talent Intelligence Architect (Agency Recruiter) to help unlock one of our platform’s most exciting opportunities: building high\-quality searches and candidate pipelines at scale. In this role, you will collaborate with AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and our MCP\-powered agents to explore new approaches, surface top talent, and shape how our platform delivers value.  

This is a hands\-on, builder\-style role for someone who thrives in a high\-autonomy, high\-accountability startup culture, embraces creative problem\-solving, and wants to make a visible impact on the success of our customers’ recruiting efforts. You'll work across dozens of customer hiring organizations simultaneously, identifying what makes searches succeed or fail at scale.

### **Responsibilities**



What you’ll be doing:


* Search Optimization: Lead the improvement of talent search effectiveness to drive better outcomes for customers.
* Synthesizing JDs at Speed: Read, decompose, and translate a wide variety of job descriptions, from niche engineering roles to executive searches, into precise Findem search attributes and queries within minutes, not hours.
* Operating AI Tools as Your Daily Workbench: Use Claude, ChatGPT, and Findem's MCP integrations to draft, refine, and pressure\-test searches. Develop prompt patterns and reusable workflows that the rest of the team can adopt.
* Cross\-Customer Intelligence: Synthesize search outcomes and pipeline quality data across multiple hiring organizations to surface repeatable patterns, failure modes, and platform improvement opportunities.
* Identifying Platform Opportunities: Spot patterns in user activity and feed structured, prioritized insights to Product and Engineering.
* Driving Customer Outcomes: Partner with engineering, customer success, and product teams to identify areas to prove value and turn customers into power users.
* Reporting and Communication: Translate findings into crisp, decision\-ready updates for internal stakeholders
* Staying on the Frontier: Track new AI tooling, MCP servers, and prompt techniques and bring the best ideas back into the workflow.
### **SKILL REQUIREMENTS**

* + **Fluency with AI Tools**: Daily, hands\-on use of Claude, ChatGPT, and ideally exposure to MCPs (Model Context Protocol) or agentic workflows. You can show concrete examples of how you have used these tools to compress hours of work into minutes.
	+ **Recruiting or Sourcing Background**: 5\+ years in agency recruiting, in\-house sourcing, RPO, or talent research. Agency or RPO background is preferred because you're already wired to think in patterns across clients, not just optimize for one. You have prior exposure to recruiting and talent acquisition software.
	+ **Rapid JD Synthesis**: A track record of taking unfamiliar role briefs across functions, industries, and seniority levels and quickly producing relevant, high\-quality candidate slates.
	+ **Analytical Instincts**: Strong command of advanced Excel or Google Sheets to track outcomes and uncover patterns in search performance across customer segments, industries, and role types. SQL or NoSQL experience is a significant advantage.
	+ **Benchmarking and Calibration:** demonstrated ability to calibrate candidate quality standards across industries, company stages, and function types.
	+ **Startup Operator Mindset**: Comfort in ambiguity, a bias toward shipping, and a habit of spotting broken workflows and fixing them without being asked. You want to own and build upon a critical piece of platform functionality, not be handed a queue.
	+ **Education**: Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent.
### **Bonus points**

* + **Advanced AI Workflow Experience**: Experience building or maintaining prompt libraries, custom GPTs, Claude Projects, or MCP\-based workflows.
	+ **Executive Recruiting:** Hands\-on experience sourcing and placing senior leaders or C\-suite executives, with a track record of managing complex market maps for a variety of industries.
	+ **Startup Background**: Experience operating inside a high\-growth SaaS or HR technology startup.  



**Based out of Bengaluru or ready to relocate to Bengaluru on immediate basis.**

title: Manager - Talent Partner
description:
**Role:** Manager \- Talent Partner
  
**Location:** Pune \& Hyderabad
  
**Experience:** 9 – 12 Years
  
About Cognizant Corporate
  
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
About the role
  
As a Talent Partner – India, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be a key member of the Human Resources team, collaborating with Talent Partner Leads, business leaders, employees, and HR teams including International HR, Immigration, and Payroll. You will provide HR expertise and consulting to assigned business units, execute the business unit talent agenda, and support employee engagement, HR processes, and people\-focused interventions while helping leaders and employees navigate day\-to\-day HR needs.
  
  

**In this role, you will:**  

* Provide HR partnership for Director and above associates by supporting both strategic and tactical initiatives for assigned business units.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with leaders and employees while providing guidance on HR policies, interpretation, and business\-related issues.
* Drive retention and engagement interventions through regular discussions, town halls, pulse checks, manager huddles, and virtual engagement initiatives.
* Support frontline manager enablement and career management activities, including manager programs, career conversations, skill architecture refreshers, and PIP tracking and closure.
* Execute employee life\-cycle processes such as merit increase, incentive administration, allowances, and YER grievance support.
* Partner with HR teams including International HR, Immigration, and Payroll to deliver robust HR services for supported groups.
* Manage employee queries and issues related to BAU processes, special initiatives, projects, and life\-cycle events through objective and effective resolution.
* Support location or country\-specific operational activities while maintaining awareness of day\-to\-day compliance requirements.


Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
* Experience in HR business partnering or a related HR role supporting business units and leaders.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of HR processes across talent, engagement, and employee life\-cycle activities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a positive attitude and drive.
* Ability to interpret policy, manage issues objectively, and work collaboratively across HR teams.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, \& Own It.


These will help you succeed
  
* Experience supporting senior stakeholders and leading employee engagement initiatives.
* Ability to identify training needs and support executive coaching or development conversations.
* Experience working across multiple HR service lines in a fast\-paced environment.


Work model – Onsite
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring presence for 5 days in a client or Cognizant office across multiple locations in India.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPRION:**




 Experience: 5\+ Years
 



 Location: Hitech City, Hyderabad, India
 



 Work Mode: In Office
 



  





**About the Role**




 We’re looking for someone who believes HR is not just about policies and processes — it’s about people, culture, and making the workplace work well for everyone.
 



 If you enjoy wearing multiple hats, solving everyday people challenges, creating great employee experiences, and occasionally being the person who ensures the onboarding deck looks great and the office runs smoothly — this role might be for you. You’ll help manage end\-to\-end HR operations along with basic office administration, supporting a collaborative and growing workplace.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing**




 People Operations
 



 • Manage the employee lifecycle process \& documentation \& tool updates — onboarding, confirmations, role changes, and exits.
 



 • Ensure employee records are accurate and up to date by maintaining all employee information, documentation, and changes in HR systems/tools.
 



 • Brings an ownership mindset – comfortable taking charge, figuring things out, and making sure work moves forward.
 



 Policies, Communication \& Presentations
 



 • Draft and maintain HR policies and internal guidelines.
 



 • Prepare HR presentations, documentation, and internal communication material.
 



 • Support leadership with people updates and HR documentation.
 



 Culture \& Engagement
 



 • Support employee engagement initiatives, team events, and internal activities.
 



 • Be a go\-to HR contact for employee queries and day\-to\-day support.
 



 Office Administration
 



 • Act as the Hyderabad point of contact for all support functions, coordinating with teams such as HR, Finance, IT, Admin, and Facilities to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations for employees in the Hyderabad office.
 



  





**Must Have:**




 • 5\+ years of experience in an HR Generalist / HR Operations role
 



 • Experience working in a startup or small\-sized organization where HR handles multiple responsibilities
 



 • Strong documentation and policy drafting skills
 



 • Comfortable creating PowerPoint presentations, HR communication decks, and internal documentation

title: SME - Sustainable Operations
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**What this job involves:** Thinking technicalWe can offer you an exciting role where you can apply your project coordination skills within our Commissioning Services team. When involved in supporting commissioning projects across construction, engineering, and MEP environments, you can encourage the team to adopt structured documentation practices and continuous improvements. You will support the execution of all coordination activities for building the commissioning delivery plan and its progression from preliminary review through to final reporting.
  
Mapping project requirementsAn essential part of your role will involve coordinating with internal team members, external consultants, contractors, and construction project teams to support documentation collection, issue resolution, project scheduling, and reporting – primarily through written communication. You will jointly manage commissioning projects by developing commissioning activity schedules and clearly defined sequences of work. Alongside, you'll maintain complete and accurate project documentation including requirements, technical reports, and progress updates, ensuring materials are organized and readily accessible. Likewise, preparing, compiling, and distributing project closeout documentation and reports using Microsoft Word, Excel, and SharePoint will be your responsibility.
  
Role synopsisThis is primarily a technical role, and JBS performs these activities with the support of one on\-site technical person for all relevant data collection. The delivery is structured as a two\-step interlinked process – an Upstream (preliminary) stage and a Downstream (final) stage – bridged by on\-site data gathering performed by the JLL On\-Shore team.
  
In the Upstream stage, you will focus on technical document review covering MEP and air\-conditioning systems such as chillers, pumps, and cooling towers, while coordinating with internal teams and MEP consultants as required. The mid\-stage handover involves the JLL on\-shore technical person visiting the project site to collect nameplate photographs of equipment, document as\-installed conditions, and capture technical parameters that cannot be obtained remotely; all collected data is then systematically passed back to JBS for analysis. In the Downstream stage, you will review the on\-site data, coordinate discussions with contractors, perform equipment calculations based on engineering standards and nameplate values, and prepare comprehensive technical reports in predefined formats.
  
Performance objectivesBeing the Commissioning Analyst, you have to ensure the required productivity and accuracy as per project requirement, approaching internal stakeholders and external partners with a best\-in\-class service provider attitude. Thinking out of the box \& supporting the building of solid relationships with consultants and contractors that are focused on the principles of partnership and resolving technical concerns with a result and win\-win attitude. Actively participate in the development of best practices around documentation, calculations, and report preparation, acting as a mentor and providing training and guidance when required to team members.
  
**Sounds like you? To apply, you need to have:** Flawless expertiseWe're looking for a person with 2 to 4 years of experience in MEP calculations and on\-site technical information review. It would be wonderful if you've worked on HVAC equipment analysis, engineering calculations, and technical documentation preparation, with the ability to read and interpret design drawings and construction submittals and a basic understanding of HVAC and electrical equipment. Strong data management, organizational, and document control skills are essential, along with proficiency in the Microsoft Office package including Word, Excel, and SharePoint. You should be comfortable managing multiple project schedules and tasks simultaneously, flexible and receptive to new ideas, and able to deal with day to day stress while effectively coordinating with diverse project stakeholders. Persistent in efforts, practicing care and caution in the job at hand, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively via email and formal correspondence.
  
Immaculate knowledgeOn top of everything else, a recognized university degree (Associate's or Bachelor's required) with an engineering background or relevant engineering experience is preferred. Prior project management experience – preferably in construction, engineering, or commissioning environments – is required. Strong attention to detail and good organizational and interpersonal skills are required to succeed in this role. Experienced candidates can expect a focused 2 to 3 months of training, while entry\-level candidates and freshers will go through a comprehensive 5 to 6 months training program to build full competency.
  
**What we can do for you:** At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Machine Learning Senior Analyst - HIH - Evernorth
description:
**Position Overview**


Are you looking for an opportunity to engineer modern application, Continuous Deployment/Continuous Integration, and embedded solutions(UI/API \& LLM) across a breadth of core platforms and technologies and foster a community while being supported with plentiful training and mentorship opportunities?


We’re looking for a Software Engineering Analyst who will be responsible to accelerate us on embedded solution(UI/API \& LLM) journey. **Responsibilities**

* Gathers and analyzes test software requirements for various applications within the organization.
* Understands a program’s architecture/design, logical and physical data models.
* Design and Develop applications built in Python/C\#
* Good exposure on AI Concepts/Models (LLM)
* Support other product delivery partners in the successful build, test, and release of solutions
* Ability to work on projects independently with minimal or no oversight required.
* Examine and discover methods to improve the accuracy, effectiveness, and dependability of data quality and support.
* Support the full software lifecycle of design, development, testing, and support for technical delivery
* Works with both (Scrum Master, Product, QA and Developers) and QA team members in properly defining testable scenarios based on requirements/acceptance criteria.
* Be part of a fast\-moving team, working with the latest tools and open\-source technologies
* Work on a development team using agile methodologies.
* Understand the Business and the Application Architecture End to End
* Solve problems by crafting software solutions using maintainable and modular code
* Participate in daily team standup meetings where you'll give and receive updates on the current backlog and challenges.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Computer Science or Engineering or related course work
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in programming, API development and UI development. We need a very clear understanding \& be able to explain how would we develop sample cases.
* Basic hands on experience working in database environments like, Oracle, SQL, MongoDB etc
* Basic exposure in using IDE like Visual Studio Code, VS Code Etc
* Good hands on experience in Python, C\#. We need some passionate young developers to work on key initiatives which are aimed at accuracy \& efficiency.
* Design, fine\-tune, and deploy LLMs for enterprise use cases.
* Integrate LLMs with legacy systems and modern cloud\-native applications.
* Develop and optimize ML models for classification, prediction, and recommendation tasks.
* Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize models in production environments.
* Contribute to front\-end and back\-end development using Vue.js, Node.js, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Work with AWS services for scalable deployment of AI/ML solutions.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with advancements in GenAI, agentic frameworks, and cloud\-native AI tooling.

**Required Experience \& Education:**

* Proven hands on experience with design, and development of large\-scale enterprise application solutions.
* College degree (Bachelor) in related technical/business areas or equivalent work experience.
* Beginner level experience in relational and NOSQL databases
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in Software engineering
* Should be flexible in working with freshers and help them guide through the programme while they learn from senior resources in project.
* Hands on experience in developing applications in Python, C\# and machine learning concepts.
* Willing to learn, go above and beyond attitudes.
* Experience with modern and legacy development languages.

**Location \& Hours of Work**

* Full\-time position, working 40 hours per week. Expected overlap with US hours as appropriate
* Primarily based in the Innovation Hub in Hyderabad, India in a hybrid working model (3 days WFO and 2 days WAH)

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality.
