title: SALES EXECUTIVE
description:
**Company Description**

Pyrotech Technologies Pvt. Ltd., formally known as Pyrotech Electronics Pvt. Ltd., is an ISO\-9001 certified manufacturing company specializing in energy\-saving LED lighting solutions. Headquartered in Udaipur, India, the organization serves commercial and institutional customers across diverse application areas. Founded in 1976, Pyrotech has maintained an average growth rate of 55% since its inception, reflecting a strong and stable market presence. Its products are manufactured using advanced machinery within a modern 50,000 sq.m. facility, ensuring quality and reliability for clients. Team members join a company committed to innovation, efficiency, and long\-term customer partnerships.

**Role Description**

This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Engineer role based in Maharashtra The Sales Engineer will work closely with customers to understand technical requirements, propose suitable LED lighting solutions, and support the sales cycle from initial inquiry to order closure. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include preparing technical proposals, conducting product demonstrations, providing pre\- and post\-sales technical support, and coordinating with internal engineering and production teams to ensure customer needs are met. The role involves regular client visits, responding to technical queries, maintaining accurate records of leads and opportunities, and contributing to sales forecasts and market feedback. The Sales Engineer will also assist in training customers on product use and participate in trade shows, presentations, and other business development activities as required.

**Skills required**

* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Sales skills to translate technical features into clear customer value and drive business growth.
* Candidates should possess solid Technical Support and Customer Service skills to address inquiries, troubleshoot issues, and maintain positive client relationships.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear spoken and written communication and effective presentation abilities.
* Candidates should ideally have knowledge of LED lighting or related electrical/electronic products and an understanding of industrial or commercial applications.
* A diploma or degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, or related field) or an equivalent technical qualification is preferred.
* Ability to work on\-site, travel to customer locations, manage time effectively, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in using productivity tools (e.g., MS Office) and basic CRM or sales tracking systems is beneficial.
* Previous experience in technical sales or engineering roles within manufacturing or lighting industries will be an advantage.

**Qualification**: Btech/B.sc or any graduate

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

description:

Good to have:

* Familiarity with mobile application security testing methodologies
* Knowledge of cloud security basics (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Relevant certifications such as CEH, eJPT, PNPT, OSCP, Security\+, or similar

Eligibility

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity / Information Technology / Computer Science or related field

Minimum 3 years of relevant cybersecurity or VAPT experience

Strong passion for application security and ethical hacking

description:

* Ability to troubleshoot networking and surveillance issues.

**Technical Knowledge**

* IP Cameras

* Wi\-Fi Configuration
* Remote Monitoring

* Ability to lift installation equipment and tools.
* Willingness to work outdoors and at various project locations.

title: Teacher - Computer
description:
BACKGROUND  

The Hans Foundation, established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works for the improvement of quality of life for underprivileged communities across India through Health, Education, Livelihood and Disability sector interventions. THF undertakes direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing funding support to not\-for\-profit organisations in India through its donor – RIST, USA. THF’s Strategic planning focuses on key areas of its work with the aim of addressing the key issues of poverty alleviation, economic inequalities, and 360° impact on the quality of life through social development programs. THF’s programs are majorly implemented in the most rural and under\-developed areas in the country. Over the years, THF has expanded its charitable activities in collaboration with State and Central Governments, institutions, corporates, academia, and non\-government organizations for sustainable interventions to achieve scale and economy. The interventions implemented by the foundation range from grass root level to national level programs.  

About Project: Hans Learning Centre is a school for children from marginalized communities (NGO). We offer admission to children between the ages of 5 and 13, for classes KG to 5\. We follow the NCERT curriculum and prepare children for NIOS exams, and/or admission to other mainstream schools.  

  

GENERAL
Location of Job: Thanagazi, Alwar, Rajasthan
Type of Employment: Part\-Time
No. of Position: 02
Reporting to: Project Coordinator  

  

JOB PURPOSE
Promote computer literacy among our students and any other individual who is keen to learn computers. You will be required to craft and present lessons, develop teaching material, and attend parent\-teacher meetings. Computer teachers should also ensure that equipment remains in excellent working condition. To ensure success as a computer teacher, you should demonstrate flexibility and support as you help students to develop confidence in their computer skills.  

WHO SHOULD APPLY?
This role is for someone who believes that every child — regardless of background — deserves to be comfortable with a computer. If you find satisfaction in a student successfully saving their first file or confidently opening a browser for the first time, this role is for you.  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
(Teaching \& Curriculum)* Design and deliver structured, age\-appropriate lessons from basics to intermediate level.
* Ensure every student achieves baseline literacy: switching on a computer, typing, file management, internet navigation, and basic software use.
* Adapt the same session for students with zero exposure and those with some prior knowledge.
* Develop hands\-on exercises and small projects that make learning practical and engaging.
* Progress learning from hardware familiarity MS Office internet skills basic digital concepts.
* Ensure enrollment of the required number of students as agreed upon with the institution.

(Student Support)* Create a patient, low\-pressure environment where students aren't afraid to ask "basic" questions.
* Identify students who are complete beginners and give them additional attention.
* Track each student's progress and communicate with parents and staff regularly.


(Lab Management)* Keep the lab clean, organised, and fully operational before every session.
* Enforce no\-food/no\-drink rules strictly.
* Perform routine checks and basic troubleshooting; coordinate with vendors for repairs.
* Maintain equipment inventory and report issues promptly.


(Assessment \& Communication)* Conduct practical assessments, quizzes, and term projects.
* Maintain grading records and give constructive feedback.
* Attend parent\-teacher meetings and share student updates clearly.


WHAT STUDENTS SHOULD BE ABLE TO DO (Learning Outcomes)
Foundational (Classes 6–8\):
* Switch on/off a computer and navigate the desktop
* Use keyboard and mouse confidently
* Manage basic files and folders
* Open, use, and close applications
* Type and save a document


Intermediate (Classes 9–12 and beyond):
* Create documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in MS Office
* Use email and manage digital files professionally
* Research online safely and critically
* Understand basic digital safety and cloud tools


EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* B.Ed. or teaching certification is preferred but not mandatory.
* Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience \& Other requirements (Behavioral, Language, Certifications etc.) Able to explain technical things in simple, everyday language.
* Teaching certification for the level at which you will be instructing.
* At least 2 years prior experience preferably with ages 12–18\.
* Genuinely passionate about making every child digitally confident, not just the "smart" ones.
* Strong written and administrative skills.
* Nurturing, adaptable approach to instructing.
* Passionate about fostering computer literacy and academic excellence.
* In depth knowledge of MS OFFICE
* Organised, responsible, and takes ownership of both students and the lab.
* Freshers with strong subject knowledge and genuine passion for teaching young learners will also be considered.
* Experience in a school lab or training centre is a plus.

  

TECHNICAL SKILLS* Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Comfortable with Windows OS and basic hardware/software troubleshooting.
* Familiar with internet tools and digital literacy concepts.
* Exposure to beginner coding (Scratch, basic Python) is a bonus, not a requirement.

 **THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.**

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations



  





**What will you do?** 



* You will design and operate the
 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.
* You will
 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.
* You will proactively identify inefficiencies, hidden delays, and context\-switching costs in everyday workflows, and redesign systems to remove them so that teams can focus on solving hard problems, not fighting tools.



  





**How will you do it?** 



* The role demands a
 *systems\-first, entrepreneurial approach* 
 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.
* You will build strong context by working closely with teams, understanding how infrastructure decisions affect productivity, security, and reliability. You will question existing practices when they add friction, and design modular, scalable solutions that can adapt as CynLr grows.
* You will have the autonomy to rethink how systems are designed, deployed, and operated, with outcomes reviewed through the lens of
 *execution quality, reliability, usability, and long\-term sustainability.* 
 Success in this role comes from balancing hands\-on execution with thoughtful design solving today’s problems while building infrastructure that remains robust tomorrow.

title: Field Sales Executive – Restaurant Partnerships
description:
**Location:** Kolkata  
**Company:** MetaHUD / Aroma  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About the Role

We are hiring confident and energetic Field Sales Executives to help us grow Aroma, a decision\-driving digital menu solution built for restaurants.

Your job is not just to distribute brochures or collect numbers. You will visit restaurants, speak with managers and decision\-makers, understand their current menu and customer\-ordering problems, present our solution clearly, and schedule meetings with restaurant owners for closure.

This is a field\-sales role for someone who is comfortable entering restaurants, starting conversations, handling objections, and following up until a meeting is fixed.

Key Responsibilities

* Visit assigned restaurants, cafés, lounges, and premium dining outlets daily.
* Identify the right point of contact, including restaurant managers, floor managers, operations heads, or owners.
* Introduce Aroma in a simple and convincing way.
* Explain how Aroma helps restaurants improve customer ordering confidence, promote premium dishes, increase add\-ons, and improve average order value.
* Understand the restaurant’s current menu system, customer behaviour, and pain points.
* Qualify restaurants based on their type, pricing, customer base, and interest level.
* Convince managers to arrange a meeting with the owner or final decision\-maker.
* Schedule and confirm owner meetings for the senior sales/closing team.
* Attend owner meetings when required and support the presentation and follow\-up process.
* Maintain daily reporting of restaurant visits, manager responses, owner meeting status, and follow\-up dates.
* Handle basic objections professionally and keep following up with interested prospects.
* Build strong relationships with restaurant managers and ensure they remain responsive during the sales process.
* Meet weekly targets for restaurant visits, qualified leads, and owner meetings booked.

Daily Expectations

* Visit multiple restaurants every day in assigned areas.
* Speak directly with managers instead of only leaving contact details.
* Collect accurate decision\-maker details wherever possible.
* Submit a daily report with:
* Restaurant name
* Contact person name and designation
* Contact number
* Restaurant category
* Interest level
* Main objection or requirement
* Next follow\-up date
* Owner meeting status

Required Skills

* Strong communication and convincing ability.
* Comfortable speaking with restaurant managers and owners.
* Confident personality with good presentation skills.
* Ability to handle rejection without losing consistency.
* Basic understanding of sales, lead generation, and follow\-ups.
* Able to use WhatsApp, Google Sheets, CRM tools, or simple reporting formats.
* Comfortable with field work and travelling within Kolkata.
* Hindi, English, and Bengali speaking ability will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* 0–2 years of experience in field sales, business development, hospitality sales, restaurant sales, digital marketing sales, or B2B sales.
* Freshers with strong confidence and communication skills may also apply.
* Candidates who have worked with restaurants, cafés, hotels, POS systems, food delivery platforms, or digital products will be preferred.
* Must be target\-oriented and disciplined with reporting.

Performance Metrics

Your performance will be measured on:

* Number of restaurants visited
* Number of meaningful manager conversations
* Number of qualified leads generated
* Number of owner meetings scheduled
* Meeting show\-up rate
* Follow\-up consistency
* Conversion support toward paid pilots and full restaurant onboarding

What We Offer

* Fixed salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Training on Aroma, restaurant sales psychology, objection handling, and pitch delivery.
* Opportunity to work directly with restaurant owners and premium hospitality businesses.
* Growth opportunity into Senior Sales Executive, Business Development Executive, or Restaurant Partnership Manager roles.

How to Apply

Send your CV along with a short introduction explaining why you are suitable for a field\-sales role in the restaurant industry.

Pay: ₹10,500\.32 \- ₹20,092\.44 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

description:
**Position:** Client Relationship Executive (B2B Field Sales – Pet Health)

**Location:** Gurgaon \& Delhi\-NCR (On\-field)

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Compensation:** Fixed Monthly Base \+ Uncapped Performance Incentives (High earning potential based on sales)

**About Us**

We are Zuno Pets, a clinical\-grade pet wellness and nutraceutical brand rewriting the rules of the pet industry. We don’t do fillers, mystery ingredients, or marketing fluff. We stand for radical transparency, scientific authority, and clean formulations that actually deliver results.

We are rapidly expanding our footprint across Delhi\-NCR and are looking for a high\-energy, relentless **Client Relationship Executive** to take our premium clinical products directly to top veterinarians, clinics, and pet hospitals. If you love animals, thrive on the field, and want a role where your paycheck directly reflects your hustle, this is for you.

**The Role: What You’ll Do**

As our B2B Field Sales Executive, you will be the face of our brand. You won't just be taking orders; you will be establishing long\-term, high\-value professional relationships with veterinary doctors from scratch.

* **On\-Field Hustle:** Map, visit, and pitch our premium supplement portfolio (including our gut and skin health lines) to veterinarians and clinic owners across Gurgaon and Delhi\-NCR.
* **B2B Relationship Management:** Educate medical professionals on our unique clinical formulations, third\-party lab testing, and the science behind our brand to build trust and drive clinical recommendations.
* **Drive Territory Sales:** Own your territory's commercial targets. Secure consistent, upfront/COD B2B stocking orders from clinics and ensure a seamless relationship cycle.
* **Market Intelligence:** Keep your pulse on the ground—track competitor activity, gather veterinarian feedback, and spot new growth opportunities.

**Who You Are (Requirements)**

We value **grit, communication skills, and hunger** over a long corporate resume.

* **The Hustler Mindset:** You are self\-motivated, target\-driven, and excited by an aggressive, uncapped incentive structure. You see a "no" as just the start of a negotiation.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of active experience in B2B field sales, client relationship management, or direct\-to\-doctor pitching (experience in pet care, wellness, high\-end FMCG, modern pharma, or diagnostic sales is a massive plus). *Exceptional, high\-energy freshers are also welcome to apply.*
* **Communication:** Fluent in Hindi and English. You must know how to confidently hold a room, command respect, and present a premium product to healthcare professionals.
* **Mobility:** Must own a two\-wheeler and a valid driving license for active, daily field movement across Delhi\-NCR.
* **Pet Lover:** A genuine empathy for animals helps, as you'll be spending your days interacting with veterinary experts and pet care professionals!

**What’s In It For You?**

* **Uncapped Earning Potential:** A fixed monthly base to cover your ground expenses, topped with a lucrative, highly aggressive incentive structure. **The more clinics you onboard and sell to, the more you make—no upper limit.**
* **Fast\-Track Leadership:** Work directly with the founding team. Prove your hustle, and you will fast\-track into a leadership/Area Manager role as we scale the regional team.
* **Pride in the Product:** You will be selling filler\-free, clinically backed products that genuinely improve pet health, giving you immense credibility on the field.

* Lead\-to\-client conversion rate.

**Position Overview:** The Site Engineer will oversee the technical and engineering aspects of interior design projects on\-site. ○ Ensure all installations and constructions meet safety and structural standards.

**4\. Project Coordination:** 

○ Collaborate with project managers, designers, and clients to ensure seamless communication and project execution.

○ Coordinate site logistics, including delivery and storage of materials.

○ Assist in developing and maintaining project schedules, tracking progress and identifying potential delays.

**5\. Health and Safety Compliance:**

○ Ensure all site activities comply with health and safety regulations.

○ Conduct regular safety meetings and site inspections to enforce safety protocols.

○ Report and document any safety incidents, ensuring appropriate actions are taken.

**6\. Documentation and Reporting:** 

○ Maintain accurate records of site activities, including daily logs, progress reports, and inspection records.

○ Prepare and submit regular project status reports to management and clients.

○ Ensure all project documentation is up\-to\-date and easily accessible.

**7\. Budget and Cost Control:**

○ Monitor project expenses and assist in budget management.

○ Identify and report any potential cost overruns or savings opportunities.

○ Ensure efficient use of resources and minimize waste.

**8\. Client and Stakeholder Interaction:**

○ Act as a liaison between clients, designers, and contractors, ensuring clear and effective communication.

○ Address client concerns and provide updates on project progress. Facilitate site visits and inspections for clients and stakeholders

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





 Visit Health is a pioneering health\-tech platform, founded in 2016 by BITS Pilani alumni, dedicated to making healthcare accessible, affordable, and preventive. Originated as a telemedicine platform during the 2015 Swine Flu epidemic, Visit Health has grown into an all\-in\-one wellness ecosystem that connects doctors, insurers, and millions of Indian families. Our services range from physical and mental wellness to OPD benefits, empowering both individuals and corporations to prioritize well\-being.
 



  





**Our Core Offerings** 




  





 \- Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Mental health support services for a balanced work\-life experience.
 



 \- Personalized Health Plans: Tailored wellness programs with fitness, meditation, and nutritional guidance.
 



 \- Health Check\-ups \& Screenings: Preventive check\-ups and vaccinations for proactive health management.
 



 \- Comprehensive Wellness Programs: Designed to boost morale, productivity, and holistic employee health.
 



 \- Preventive \& OPD Care: Seamless primary care and OPD services, reducing out\-of\-pocket expenses through cashless OPD benefits.
 



  





**Founding Team** 




  





 The founding team — Chetan Anand, Anurag Prasad, Vaibhav Singh, and Shashvat Tripathi — established Visit Health to bridge the healthcare gap in India. Driven by their experiences with limited healthcare access in Pilani, they have built Visit Health into a platform that advocates quality, accessible healthcare for everyone.
 



  





**What Sets Us Apart** 




  





 \- Comprehensive \& Flexible OPD Benefits: Visit offers unlimited access packages for employees and dependents, covering mental health, nutrition, diagnostics, and doctor consultations.
 



 \- Integrated Platform: Combining primary and secondary care, our platform connects corporates, insurers, and retailers, making healthcare seamless and holistic.
 



 \- Engagement \& Gamification: AI\-driven insights, step challenges, and rewards (FitCoins) drive high engagement and builds lasting healthy habits.
 



 \- 24/7 Accessibility: Accessible health support anytime, designed to address India’s diverse healthcare needs.
 



  





**Key Milestones \& Achievements** 




  





 \- Expanding Primary Care Access: Serving over 5 million users with 1\.5 million annual health checkups, 500,000 doctor consultations, and 200,000 pharmacy orders.
 



 \- Strategic Partnerships: Collaborations with leading insurers and doctors, reaching 2,500 major Indian corporations and MSMEs.
 



 \- Technological Innovation: Introduced India’s first cashless OPD insurance program in partnership with Apollo Munich, with a network of over 35,000 doctors.
 



 \- Awards \& Recognition: Honored in Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia (2020\) and BITSAA Global 30 Under 30 (2022\).
 



 \- Funding Success: Secured over $40 million in investments to drive growth and service expansion.
 



  





**Future Vision** 




  





 Visit Health aims to further strengthen India’s primary care infrastructure, expand its corporate and insurer partnerships, and introduce advanced health tech solutions. With a focus on universal health coverage, we’re committed to making healthcare accessible for all employees and their families, supporting them in leading healthier lives.
 



  





 Visit Health — Empowering workplaces with accessible, affordable, and impactful healthcare.
 



  





**We are looking for Associate Product Manager to join our high\-energy team.** 




  





 You will have a direct impact on redefining the Health Benefits Programs in the Indian corporate landscape. This is a vast and complex domain and will involve solving challenges in our core primary care services, insurance, and broker\-related services, user engagement, and gamification. You'll work as part of a high\-energy team and interact with teams across engineering, design, operations, growth, marketing, category, finance, and legal.
 



  





**As part of your day\-to\-day work, you will** 




  





 ● Define and Execute a strategy to work towards solving employee, employer, and partner problems that are aligned with Visit’s business goals.
 



 ● Launch new products and features, guide their go\-to\-market, evaluate their success, and iterate based on feedback.
 



 ● Develop solutions collaborating with Engineering and Design teams across Visit as required.
 



 ● Own the end\-to\-end product roadmap derived from employee, employer, and partner feedback and Visit business strategy
 



  





**Must Have's** 




  





 ● 2\+ years of work experience in a product or product\-adjacent role like tech, design, growth, strategy
 



 ● Prior startup experience
 



 ● Candidate should have experience in E\-Commerce
 



 ● Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills

**About the Role** 




 At mCaffeine \& Hyphen, we're looking for a Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst who can transform data into strategic business decisions. This role sits at the intersection of business, data, technology, and operations, driving key initiatives across growth, supply chain, finance, product, and customer experience functions.
 



 As a trusted partner to business leaders, you will identify opportunities, solve complex business problems, build scalable reporting frameworks, and influence decision\-making through actionable insights. If you thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy working with ambiguity, and are passionate about using data to create business impact, we'd love to meet you.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Partner with leadership and cross\-functional teams to identify business opportunities, define problem statements, and drive data\-backed decision\-making.
* Translate business requirements into structured analytical frameworks, functional specifications, and actionable solutions.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover trends, diagnose business challenges, and recommend strategic interventions.
* Design, build, and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and KPI tracking mechanisms to provide visibility into business performance.
* Drive end\-to\-end analytics projects, from requirement gathering and stakeholder alignment to execution and impact measurement.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Operations, and Finance teams to implement scalable business solutions.
* Identify process inefficiencies and champion automation initiatives to improve operational effectiveness and decision\-making speed.
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on customer behavior, marketing performance, retention, supply chain, and business profitability metrics.
* Establish data governance, reporting standards, and best practices to improve data quality and reliability across the organization.
* Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a clear, concise, and business\-friendly manner.



  





**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* High ownership, bias for action, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field from a Tier 1 Institute.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience working with D2C, E\-commerce, Retail, Consumer Brands, or high\-growth startup ecosystems.
* Exposure to customer analytics, marketing analytics, supply chain analytics, or product analytics.
* Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and cloud platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or AWS.

title: MTS - Software Development
description:
**Who We Are**
 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai
   

  

**About the Role \- Member of Technical Staff – Backend Engineering \- SaaS Platform**
 Aviatrix Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) delivers the intelligence, advanced networking, and security services of Aviatrix’s multi\-cloud platform as a managed offering. Our SaaS platform serves enterprise customers with a reliable, secure, and scalable product built on modern microservices and cloud\-native backend architectures.
   

  

 We are looking for a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) – Backend Engineering to join our SaaS Platform team. This role is ideal for an early\-career backend engineer with a strong foundation in software development and curiosity to grow in distributed systems and cloud technologies. You will work closely with senior engineers, contribute to microservices development, and grow in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Feature Development \& Delivery**
* Design, implement, test, and ship reliable and maintainable backend features and services.
* Build and extend Golang\-based microservices using REST and gRPC patterns.
* Participate across the development lifecycle, including design, code review, deployment, and monitoring.
* Write clean, well\-tested code and help maintain high code quality standards.


**Collaboration \& Growth**
* Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and peers to deliver platform features.
* Participate in design discussions, bringing curiosity and a willingness to learn.
* Incorporate feedback from code reviews and document APIs, service behavior, and runbooks clearly.
* Continuously build knowledge of backend, cloud\-native, and distributed system concepts.


**Platform \& Operations**
* Contribute to service reliability by adding logs, metrics, and alerts as part of feature delivery.
* Assist with deploying and operating services on AWS following team standards.
* Help identify and address performance issues, reliability gaps, and technical debt.
* Participate in on\-call rotations as you grow into the role.


**Requirements**
**Experience \& Education**
* 1–3 years of backend software engineering experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals and experience shipping backend features in production.


**Backend \& Cloud**
* Proficiency in a strongly typed backend language; Golang experience is a strong plus.
* Understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, distributed systems, and basic data modeling.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or another public cloud platform.
* Familiarity with containers (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and Git\-based workflows.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Golang and gRPC\-based services.
* Exposure to event\-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS).
* Familiarity with Kubernetes or infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Interest in cloud networking, security, or SaaS platforms.


**Interpersonal \& Communication**
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback.
* Strong eagerness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced engineering team.


 Watch our culture video: glimpse of life at Aviatrix
   

  

**Benefits**
**US** 
 : We cover 100% of employee premiums and 88% of dependent(s) premiums for medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) match, short and long\-term disability, life/AD\&D insurance, $1,000/year education reimbursement, and a flexible vacation policy.
   

  

**Outside the US:** 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package which, (subject to regional variations) could include pension, private medical for you and dependents, generous holiday allowance, life assurance, long\-term disability, annual wellbeing stipend
   

  

 Your total compensation package will be based on job\-related knowledge, education, certifications and location, per our aligned ranges.
   

  

**About Aviatrix**
**Aviatrix®** 
 is the cloud network security company trusted by more than 500 of the world’s leading enterprises. As cloud infrastructures become more complex and costly, the Aviatrix Cloud Network Security platform gives companies back the power, control, security, and simplicity they need to modernize their cloud strategies. Aviatrix is the only secure networking solution built specifically for the cloud, that ensures companies are ready for AI and what’s next. Combined with the Aviatrix Certified Engineer (ACE) Program, the industry’s leading secure multicloud networking certification, Aviatrix unifies cloud, networking, and security teams and unlocks greater potential across any cloud.
   

  

**WE WANT TO INCLUDE YOU**
 We embrace the fact that not everyone’s journey took the same route or started at the same place. If your experience doesn’t quite meet the requirements but the opportunity excites you and you believe you could be great, don’t let that hold you back from applying. Tell us what you CAN bring and what makes you special.
   

  

 Aviatrix is a community where everyone's career can grow and we want to help you achieve your goals and be “your best YOU,” however that looks. If you're seeking an opportunity where you can be excited to start work every morning with enthusiastic people, make a real difference and be part of something amazing then let’s talk. We want to get to know you and how we could grow together.

**Job Summary**
 JOB DESCRIPTION – Human Resources Director
   

  

 Location: New Delhi\- India
   

  

 Division: Ticketmaster
   

  

 Line Manager: Vice President, Human Resources
   

  

 Contract Terms: Permanent, 40 hours per week
   

  

 THE TEAM
   

  

 The Tech HR Team works closely with Tech, Product, Sports and Tournaments and Ticketmaster Music, business areas as well as the UK and Ireland region. As a team we help drive alignment on HR practices to achieve strategic business objectives while upholding Ticketmaster’s core values.
   

  

 HR professionals on this team develop meaningful relationships with employees across the business areas to foster equity and reinforce the continued adoption of HR best practices and delivery of business objectives. We drive evidence\-based decision making, leveraging people data, feedback, and context to provide strategic guidance to business leads.
   

  

 THE JOB
   

  

 The HR Director role is a leading role in our HR Business Partner function. Working with key stakeholders and leading the HRBP Team to help build organization and people capability, and shape and implement effective people strategies and activities within the organization. The HRD role has an excellent understanding of Ticketmaster’s organizational strategy, culture, vision, mission, values, and strategic objectives and helps galvanize the HR Team and business leads around these key components to Ticketmaster’s success.
   

  

 The role will be based in the New Delhi office directly supporting the client group based in India. The role’s primary function is to build partnership with business leads, to problem solve with them and to help build long term team success. The role requires being solution orientated, able to understand business challenges, and through discussion and partnership, help to build those solutions. Additionally the role will be responsible for identifying the long term success factors for the teams it supports, in order to then be able to identify the changes needed to ensure the team is able to achieve its goals. Through these two core responsibilities the role will be able to leverage the various resources and tools of Talent Management available, together with the support of partners within the business.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
**Talent Management**
* Partner with and provide direction to business leads on all aspects of talent management, organization design, role design, workforce planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.
* Work closely with the VP HR, hiring managers and Talent Acquisition, to establish and forecast people needs, establish staffing priorities, and direct related changes.
* Provide direction in senior management meetings in response to current and future departmental activities. Have a deep understanding of the objectives of the business and acts as partner on all people\-related matters.
* Oversee and design the on\-boarding process for the department or region.
* Identifying and evaluating turnover and retention and provide direction on focus areas to mitigate voluntary attrition.
* Analyze employee survey results and guide the leadership team(s) to develop departmental strategies based on feedback/results.
* Assist managers in designing the principles to identify their talent and the design of learning assessment tools
* Partner with the Learning \& Development team in the design and facilitation of training and education programs linked to development plans.
* Coach snr managers and employees on career development including the design of Development Plans
* Partner with managers and Compensation on Job Levelling to ensure consistent and maintained leveling integrity as well as facilitate the feedback on leveling design.
* Take ownership and oversee people data for the assigned client group.


**HR Partnerships**

 YOU (BEHAVIOURAL)
   

  

* Reliability\- Ability to complete tasks on a consistent basis to a consistently good standard. As you progress through your career this will represent being able to handle an increasingly large, complex, and varied workload, balancing the prioritization of that load and maintaining on equitable approach to it as well.
* Leadership\- from a technical and strategic point of view, able to understand and devise strategies to lead the team forward but, leadership on an interpersonal level, helping teams with change management and coaching them through progress with effective communication.
* Adaptability\- an ability to pivot not just yourself to changing priorities but also ensure you are helping your team and colleagues with understanding and adapting to those changes. You will also have to deal with often competing priorities from client groups, with very different needs and sometimes culture. Shifting between those two worlds in a way that can balance efficiency of standard processes with bespoke outcomes.
* Problem Solving\- knowledgeable about the potential impacts on equity that your solutions can cause. Solving problems in a more systematic way and, less ad hoc in ways that can deliver outcomes equitably and with clear logic to justify them.
* Integrity\- HR must have integrity at its core. As an area that relies on employees to trust us in order to provide support in the most difficult of times. In the early parts of your career this will mostly focus on staying connected to our policies and processes to not waver and create inconsistency. As you advance in your career the complexity of problems faced will make decisions harder, but you will have to stay grounded and lean more on our philosophy and values to ensure you keep that level of integrity throughout the work we do. In the expert levels of your career, you will need to be able to demonstrate integrity at the highest levels of discussion representing our values and challenging senior leaders with the right questions and guidance centered on equity.
* People Management\- You will manage a large team across multiple time zones and regions, employing strategies that impact the whole team, managing and planning work across the whole team. In addition, you will be able to create development plans which span the whole team.
* Managing Relationships\- This will extend to managing relationships with leadership and exec levels around complex problems and projects.
* Teamwork\- You will understand the individual needs across the team and, how to best utilize the resources and tool available to prioritize initiatives to best deliver for the whole team. You can also measure and direct appropriate members of the team to support.


 LIFE AT TICKETMASTER
   

  

 We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.
   

  

 Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.
   

  

 We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Our Work Is Guided By Our Values**
**Reliability** 
 \- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.
   

  

**Teamwork** 
 \- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team
   

  

**Integrity** 
 \- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent
   

  

**Belonging** 
 \- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive
   

  

 EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES
   

  

 We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.
   

  

 Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

description:
**About Us:** 




 MUFG Bank, Ltd. is Japan’s premier bank, with a global network spanning in more than 40 markets. Outside of Japan, the bank offers an extensive scope of commercial and investment banking products and services to businesses, governments, and individuals worldwide. MUFG Bank’s parent, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. (MUFG) is one of the world’s leading financial groups. Headquartered in Tokyo and with over 360 years of history, the Group has about 120,000 employees and offers services including commercial banking, trust banking, securities, credit cards, consumer finance, asset management, and leasing.
 



 The Group aims to be the world’s most trusted financial group through close collaboration among our operating companies and flexibly respond to all the financial needs of our customers, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. MUFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York stock exchanges.
 



  





**Position Title:** 
 Performance Management Specialist/SME, Global Performance, Reward and Benefits (PRB), Global Human Resources (GHR)
 



**Corporate Title:** 
 Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Job Profile:** 




 GHR Transformation is GHR’s global HR target operating model transformation. It sets a new globally aligned direction for HR, guided by industry\-leading practices, to achieve greater alignment and more efficient delivery of HR services to add deeper value to the business.
 



 Key responsibilities include: (1\) Serving as a PRB offshoring Subject Matter Expert and advisory team member to the Global PRB COE, GHR Transformation Steering Committee, Global Process Owners and Transition Leads to help determine which services and underlying processes should be offshored to MGS; (2\) Developing and implementing the PRB operating model, processes, and procedures required to successfully receive, operationalize, and sustain the GHR PRB services and processes transitioned to MGS; (3\) Support the MGS PRB Head to help plan and execute the transition of the agreed services and underlying processes to be offshored to MGS, including completion of the internal due diligence and governance steps.
 



  





**Position details (To be filled by business):** 




 This position will report directly to the MGS PRB Head, GHR and will be responsible for standing up and operationalizing the GHR PRB MGS service delivery model. This role will interact with senior leaders and team members from across Global PRB COE and the company to drive the GHR PRB target operating model outcomes and deliver results.
 



 This is a 40\-hour per week position with Monday through Friday work hours. The position works globally, and scheduling flexibility is required to allow for regular meetings and connectivity with colleagues in the Americas, APAC, and EMEA time zones.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities (To be filled by business):** 



* Serve as an offshoring Subject Matter Expert on Performance Management and support the MGS PRB Head to help plan and execute the transition of the agreed services and underlying processes to be offshored to MGS, including completion of the required internal due diligence and governance steps prior to go\-live. Leverage offshoring experience and expertise to infuse leading practices and lessons learned to support successful identification and transition of services.
* Design and deliver an enhanced best\-in\-class global performance management framework and processes addressing pain points and meeting the requirements of our clients and stakeholders
* Spearhead key initiatives such as establishing Global Calibration Guidelines, Global Breach Process (with consequence management for non\-timely completion of prescribed performance review tasks), and Global Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)
* Develop and maintain communication and training materials on all our performance review processes to guide our clients on completing these processes effectively, including upkeep of the performance management policy and procedures and job aids or user guides.
* Develop and maintain the annual performance management calendar for the Bank
* Partner with other teams such as Talent, Learning and Culture to delineate roles and responsibilities as well as synchronize performance management processes and timelines, with career development planning and other talent nuances
* Work closely with Global HRIS Lead to ensure Workday Performance Management functionalities are tested and setup to deliver on our processes seamlessly
* Support in developing and implementing the MGS PRB operating model, processes, and procedures required to successfully receive, operationalize, and sustain the GHR PRB services and processes transitioned to MGS. Socialize corresponding deliverables for feedback and approvals with key GHR, MGS, and Global Efficiency Office (GEO) stakeholders.
* Help complete all required internal due diligence processes and documentation related to the service transition and offshoring work, in coordination with the respective stakeholders/teams
* Maintain ongoing communications and coordination with the Onshore BU/COE teams, successfully receive, operationalize (e.g., service level agreements (SLAs), metrics, procedures, etc.), and monitor GHR PRB services and underlying processes migrating to MGS.
* Partner with the Onshore global BU/COE colleagues, to deliver a truly global PRB agenda. Focusing on spearheading the PRB globalization agenda and developing best in class global processed
* Lead and mentor junior MGS PRB analysts/administrators to ensure services and processes transitioned to MGS are delivered in line with agreed service standards.



  





**Job Requirements: (To be filled by business):** 



* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 7\+ years demonstrated experience and a demonstrated track record for driving offshoring results, with expertise in building, operationalizing, and managing offshoring for a global PRB COE.
* Possesses deep knowledge and experience with PRB offshoring and can leverage leading practices, lessons learned, and expertise to enable smooth transitions, accelerate progress, and achieve results.
* Understands and has experience with the PRB COE, preferably gained with the Banking sector, and is knowledgeable of PRB COE service delivery models, prevailing global PRB related regulations and market trends.
* Possesses strong collaboration and influence skills; able to address stakeholders’ needs, while managing them to maintain progress and achieve results.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Must be able to develop and present deliverables to executive level audiences.
* Able to address and resolve complex problems and effectively prioritize competing objectives. The ability to negotiate and manage conflict is critical.



  





**Technical Skills:**

* Intellectually curious, with the ability to identify and assess problems and define and execute innovative, yet pragmatic solutions
* Results driven, with a strong sense of accountability and a proactive, motivated approach

* Ability to take a structured and logical approach to work
* Ability to manage large workloads and tight deadlines and perform well in a pressurized environment
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
* Possess flexibility to work well independently as well as with others

title: Employee Relations Lead -India
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 The Employee Relations team operates as a Center of Excellence within Airbnb’s People team. ER professionals are not simply case handlers — they are strategic partners who build the frameworks, guidelines, and operating principles that uphold Airbnb’s culture at scale. This role shapes how the organization navigates complex workplace matters with consistency, fairness, and integrity. You will partner across Talent (HR), Legal, and business leadership to drive sound decision\-making rooted in trust, mutual respect, and accountability. Success is not measured by cases closed. It is measured by the quality of outcomes, the strength of the practices we embed across the organization, and whether our work reinforces the culture and values that make Airbnb, Airbnb.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make**
 We’re looking for an individual with strong Employee Relations (ER) expertise to join the ER team at Airbnb. This individual will be an instrumental part of the ER team, which includes implementing and improving frameworks, guidelines, approaches, practices and operating principles. Building and reinforcing Airbnb’s culture is a key requirement for this position.
   

  

 The successful candidate will establish relationships across the organization and provide ER subject matter expertise in order to support the mission, culture and values of Airbnb, with a focus on India and APAC region. The incumbent manages intake and prioritization of ER cases; collaborates with Legal and Talent partners and serves on statutory committees such as the POSH Committee, as applicable under Indian law.
   

  

**A Typical Day**
**Case Management**
* Conduct end\-to\-end investigations, including intake, evidence gathering, credibility determinations, written investigation reports, and recommendations on appropriate courses of action, with minimal guidance.
* Conduct interviews with exceptional thoughtfulness, clarity, and procedural responsibility, ensuring psychological safety, neutrality, and cultural sensitivity throughout.
* Work closely with Legal to ensure awareness of laws applicable to investigations across APAC geographies and adapt interview and investigation approaches accordingly.
* Ensure cases are handled fairly, consistently, transparently, in a timely fashion, and in line with Airbnb culture, policies, and appropriate local laws.
* Advise on and lead employee relations investigations across functions and regions working in partnership with Talent (HR), Legal, and compliance related teams.
* Counsel Talent (HR) and business leaders on ER issues, trends and risks to foster sound business decisions.
* Advise Talent (HR) and management on how to handle performance issues and complex disciplinary matters using specialized knowledge of performance management concepts, principles and practices.
* Deliver training offerings depending on company needs and external regulations.


**ER Consulting**
* Contribute to the development, socialization and rollout of ER processes, strategy, approaches, guidelines, practices and operating procedures.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders at varying levels of seniority, including senior stakeholders, by modeling trustworthiness, discretion, confidentiality, empathy and sound judgment.
* Actively collaborate across global Employee Relations, Talent (HR), Legal, and Compliance teams, bringing openness to diverse approaches and sharing APAC\-specific context that informs global strategy.
* Drive ER efforts that support Talent (HR) and business initiatives.
* Conduct training for leaders, managers, employees, Talent Partners and other stakeholders.
* Proactively identify trends through data analysis and use insights to inform and develop resources, process improvements and training.
* Collect, analyze, interpret and make recommendations on ER related data; maintain organized case management systems.
* Adapt ER programs and approaches to the needs of the business, function, and/or region.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with the Airbnb’s leadership team at its Global Capability Center based in India, acting as the on\-the\-ground Employee Relations partner for a high\-growth, multi\-functional workplace.


**Strategic Planning \& Operations**
* Support the Employee Relations (ER) framework for their client groups, contributing to strategies and proposals to continuously drive improvements in ER practices within the organization based on trust, mutual respect, strong performance management, and accountability.
* Contribute to communications efforts that promote ER best practices throughout the organization.
* Assess employment risk in coordination with Talent (HR) leadership and Legal based on current regulatory landscape and anticipated changes, drawing on specialized knowledge of employment policies and regulations.
* Design, document, and implement ER workflows and processes where gaps exist or legacy approaches are insufficient, driving efficiency without sacrificing rigour or fairness.
* Should have the knowledge / experience to implement, use and adapt to case management platforms and technological tools to manage and improve investigation documentation, trend identification, deriving insights on workflows, and ER reporting efficiency.
* Monitor/interpret developments in India's evolving Labour Code framework (e.g. Industrial Relations, Social Security Codes) and work closely with Legal and Talent (HR) to proactively update internal practices and documentation standards.


**Your Expertise**
* 10\+ years of Employee Relations/Human Resources experience, including managing investigations
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong ability to analyse large, complex sets of data and multi\-faceted factual scenarios, synthesising competing evidence into clear, well\-reasoned, and robust findings.
* Demonstrated experience working within or supporting a Global Capability Centre (GCC), shared\-services, or multi\-national matrixed environment.
* Ability to maintain composure, remain positive, collaborative and objective while under pressure and dealing with senior leaders and complex issues
* Proven track record of positively influencing stakeholders at varying levels of seniority
* Ability to coach, mentor, advise and partner with stakeholders at varying levels of seniority
* Specialized knowledge of ER, labor relations, training, conflict resolution and direct experience leading investigations with minimal guidance.
* Strong understanding of employment\-related state and federal laws \& regulations
* Strong preference for direct experience supporting international ER matters
* Comfortable leveraging generative AI tools (e.g.,Claude, Gemini, etc.) to accelerate daily tasks
* Demonstrated ability to assess and mitigate employment risks with sound business acumen
* Sound judgment and strong decision\-making skills; experienced in handling sensitive and confidential matters
* Ability to be discreet and maintain confidentiality is required
* Self\-motivated with strong ability to prioritize and plan in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Comfortable working across APAC and US time zones as a standard part of the role; must be open to working outside core hours when reasonably required to support global stakeholders, time\-sensitive investigations, or cross\-regional ER matters.
* Some travel may be required


**Our Commitment To Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively\-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**How We'll Take Care Of You**
 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
   

  

 India Annual Pay Range
   

  

 ₹4,270,000—₹6,100,000 INR

**Skills And Experience Needed For This Job**

* Experience working as a Manager of Record or equivalent comfortable owning employee records, escalation handling, and compliance for a defined employee population.
* Strong interpersonal skills you can build trust with employees and managers at all levels.
* Data discipline you keep records clean, generate reports accurately, and use data to spot issues before they become problems.
* Execution mindset you close things. You are not someone who needs to be followed up with.
* Comfortable with ambiguity Sahana is a fast\-moving environment. You adapt quickly and do not need everything to be defined before you start.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Operational Excellence: Zero compliance misses in your employee population. Records are accurate, timely, and audit\-ready.
* Manager Experience: Managers in your business units feel supported, not left to figure out HR on their own.
* Attrition: Regrettable attrition in your aligned functions trends down. You are catching signals and acting on them.
* Turnaround Time: Employee queries and lifecycle events are handled within agreed SLAs consistently.
* Grievance Handling: Grievances are resolved fairly and quickly, with documentation that holds up to scrutiny.
* Business Partnership: Business leads proactively loop you in on team decisions. You are a trusted partner, not a formality.



  





**Leadership and Ownership Traits You Must Have** 



* Strong Execution: You run the HR engine. Plans get done. Loops get closed. No hand\-holding required.
* Operational Rigour: You care about accuracy, compliance, and process integrity. Details matter to you.
* Ownership Mindset: You own outcomes end\-to\-end not just your slice of the process.
* Generalist Depth: You are comfortable across the full HR spectrum from transactional to relational.
* High Accountability: You take responsibility when things go wrong and fix them with clear actions and timelines.
* Commercial Awareness: You understand the business context behind people decisions and act accordingly.

title: HR Processing Assistant
description:
**Description**
 ICF (www.icf.com) is a consultancy firm with offices in the UK, Belgium, the US and worldwide. At ICF, we help governments, public agencies and international institutions solve complex problems and improve the quality of life of people around the world. We offer critical insight and rigorous analytical techniques to deliver innovative solutions and thought\-provoking analyses for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Processing \& Employee Transactions Specialist is an experienced HR operations professional responsible for the end\-to\-end execution and validation of employee lifecycle transactions in Workday and related HR systems (e.g. new hires, job changes, terminations) with accuracy and timeliness. The role ensures data integrity and compliance by auditing all HR data changes, adhering to internal controls (including SOX) and service level agreements (SLAs). This role partners closely with HR Business Partners, Payroll, Recruiting and other stakeholders to resolve issues and ensure
 *zero* 
 downstream payroll or reporting errors. The role also supports payroll readiness through proactive discrepancy resolution, actively contributes to process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives, and maintains thorough documentation while upholding confidentiality, data security, and high customer service standards. The ideal candidate not only executes processes diligently but also seeks to learn and improve those processes to enhance overall team performance.
   

  

 This position can be hybrid or fully remote with ability to travel as needed to our Bangalore or New Delhi, India locations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Transaction Processing: Perform and validate accurate, timely processing of employee data changes in Workday and other HR systems (onboarding, promotions, transfers, terminations, compensation changes, etc.) ensuring all transactions are completed within prescribed timelines and quality standards.
* Data Audit \& Compliance: Audit completed transactions end\-to\-end to ensure data accuracy, compliance with internal controls and policies (including SOX requirements), and readiness for internal/external audits. Take corrective action immediately to prevent any downstream errors (e.g. payroll or reporting issues).
* Payroll Support: Coordinate closely with the payroll team by reviewing HR changes for pay\-impacting issues, identifying and correcting discrepancies, and confirming all necessary adjustments so that payroll runs smoothly and on schedule.
* Work Queue Management: Manage and prioritize daily work queues of requests (e.g. ticketing system, shared inbox, Workday tasks), maintaining SLAs and high quality on each case to ensure timely, customer\-focused resolutions.
* Process Improvement Projects: Actively contribute to HR operations projects, audits, and system enhancements by providing subject\-matter input and helping implement process improvements (leveraging tools and automation where possible).
* Documentation \& Reporting: Prepare and maintain detailed audit logs, trackers, reports, and metrics to provide visibility into data quality, compliance issues, and process performance. Ensure all transaction records and documentation are comprehensive and readily available for audit and reporting purposes.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with HR Business Partners (HRBPs), Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to troubleshoot complex cases, resolve data issues, and continuously optimize HR processes in alignment with business needs.
* Governance \& Controls: Ensure strict adherence to all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), data privacy regulations, security guidelines, and the company’s code of conduct when handling sensitive employee information. Take ownership of assigned tasks with minimal supervision, promptly escalating any risks or non\-compliance issues through the proper channels to achieve resolution.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify inefficiencies or recurring issues in daily operations and recommend solutions to streamline workflows and improve data quality. Contribute to team best practices and help keep process documentation and knowledge repositories up to date as processes evolve.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Experience: 2\+ years of professional experience in an operations or administrative role with defined processes and performance metrics (SLAs), including at least 1 year in HR data processing or HR operations handling sensitive employee data and transactions.
* Technical Skills: Hands\-on experience performing HR transactions on a Workday or a similar HR Information System (minimum 1 year). Demonstrated proficiency with standard business software, especially Microsoft Excel, for data review and reporting in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree or MBA in a relevant field (e.g. Human Resources, Business Administration).
* Professional HR certification (e.g. PHR, SHRM\-CP) or Workday HCM certification.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Detail Orientation: Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and validation tasks.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to convey information clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Customer Focus: Strong customer service orientation, ensuring high levels of satisfaction for internal clients and stakeholders.
* Time Management: Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, meet tight deadlines, and adapt in a fast\-paced, high\-volume work environment.
* Collaboration: Effective team player who can work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate with colleagues across global/remote teams and time zones.
* Analytical \& Proactive Mindset: Solid problem\-solving and decision\-making skills, with a process\-oriented approach and a proactive drive for continuous improvement in HR operations.


**Working at ICF**
 ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting\-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.
   

  

**Candidate AI Usage Policy**
 At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in\-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.
   

  

 However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.
   

  

 Bangalore, India (II78\)

 The
 **GEO POPS Specialist**

 **execution authority and market operator**

 **translating policy and statutory requirements into day‑to‑day execution**

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. * Run GEO‑level execution for assigned countries across the hire‑to‑retire local layer.
* Execute statutory operations, authority correspondence, filings, and local documentation workflows.
* Act as the single POPS escalation point for employee‑impacting issues within scope.
* Risk signaling \& evidence stewardship
* Identify and flag risks early, providing facts, evidence, and options, maintaining documentation required for audits/inspections.

* Execute within defined controls, signatory rules, and delegation frameworks.

* Coordinate day‑to‑day vendor execution (as applicable), validate outputs, and escalate quality/compliance risks with evidence.
* Continuous improvement \& knowledge assets
* Contribute to process improvements, playbooks, documentation, and knowledge assets are current.
* Support transformation, transitions to automation or outsourced models through execution rigor, e.g. \- shift work to Tier 1 / Tier 2 where appropriate; reduce manual, country specific complexity; support automation and Employee Hub maturity.

* 5\+ years experience in HR, Customer Support, or related field
+ OR Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field AND 3\+ years experience in Operations, Customer Support, HR, or related field.
+ Strong operational HR execution skills with local statutory awareness (India,APAC \& ANZ) and ability to translate abstract policy into practical, executable steps
+ Demonstrated ability to work with metrics, dashboards, and trend analysis to inform operational decisions

title: AI Research Scientist
description:
AI Research Scientist \| UV Netware
   

  

 Location: Vadodara, Gujarat (Hybrid)
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
