title: Backend Engineer
description:
About Jetbro
   


 Jetbro is a technology consulting and systems integration firm that builds reliable, scalable digital systems for organizations where technology is central to operations. We work across custom product development, enterprise applications, and infrastructure\-led digital transformation for clients ranging from Fortune 500 companies to high\-growth startups across India, Australia, and Canada.
   




 Our philosophy is simple: build systems that work quietly, predictably, and under pressure. We value clarity over complexity and reliability over noise.
   

 About the Role
   


 We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team working on a high\-traffic consumer technology platform. You will build and maintain APIs, services, and data pipelines that power real\-time user experiences at scale.
   





 This is a polyglot role. Our backend spans Node.js (Express) and Python (FastAPI, Django), with both MySQL and PostgreSQL databases. You will move between languages and frameworks depending on what the problem demands. If you are the kind of engineer who gets uncomfortable being locked into one stack, you will fit right in.
   





 You will use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as everyday tools. We expect you to be proficient with them, not just familiar. Knowing how to prompt, review AI\-generated code critically, and ship faster because of it is a core part of how we work.
   




 Key Responsibilities
   

* Write clean, testable backend code in TypeScript/JavaScript (Express) and Python (FastAPI/Django)
* Design and maintain database schemas and optimize queries for performance
* Build and extend APIs that handle real user traffic at scale• Use AI coding assistants effectively to accelerate development without sacrificing code quality
* Collaborate with frontend engineers, DevOps, and project leads
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions
* Own features end\-to\-end: from understanding requirements to deployment and monitoring


 Requirements
   

  

 What You'll Work On
   

* RESTful APIs serving high\-traffic consumer applications
* Event pipelines, click tracking, and analytics infrastructure
* Database design, query optimization, and migrations across MySQL and PostgreSQL
* Integration with third\-party services and internal microservices
* Background jobs, scheduling, and async processing
* Production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning


 Tech Stack
   

* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, JavaScript, Python
* **Backend frameworks:** 
 Express.js, FastAPI, Django
* **Databases:** 
 MySQL, PostgreSQL
* **Infrastructure:** 
 Docker, CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments (GCP/AWS)
* **AI tools:** 
 Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
* **Other:** 
 Redis, message queues, REST APIs, Git


 Who is this Role for
   


 This role is a great fit if:
   




* You have 0\-4 years of backend engineering experience
* You are comfortable working across multiple languages and frameworks
* You actively use AI coding assistants and understand their strengths and limits
* You care about writing code that other people can read and maintain
* You enjoy working on systems that serve real users at real scale
* You learn fast and don't need to be told twice


 What we care more about than your resume
   

* Adaptability \> deep expertise in one framework
* AI\-fluency \> years of experience
* Clear thinking \> buzzwords
* Ownership mindset \> following instructions
* Side projects, experiments, GitHub repos, or well\-documented failures are a big plus


 Bonus (Nice to Have, Not Required)
   

* Experience with high\-traffic systems or event\-driven architectures
* Exposure to click tracking, analytics pipelines, or real\-time data processing
* Understanding of system design fundamentals
* Experience with containerization and deployment workflows


 Benefits
   

  

 Growth at Jetbro
   


 If you do well, this role can grow into:
   




* Senior Backend Engineer
* Platform / Infrastructure Engineer
* System Architect (longer term)


 We invest heavily in people who invest in learning.

description:
**About ValGenesis**
 ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
   

  

 Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

**Job Description:** 
 We are looking for junior/associate software engineer who could join our cloud product engineering team to build, sustain the enterprise applications for our global customers. As part of this internship, you’ll learn how to develop and test code efficiently while gaining real world experience working on applications that support our customers. With mentoring from Senior Developers, the intern will learn multiple systems and be able to use their skills in multiple projects and maintenance, and coordinate with the rest of the team working on different layers of the infrastructure.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Assist in designing, building, and maintaining efficient, reusable, and reliable code by writing clean, scalable code using Azure cloud services, C\# .NET Core, ReactJS etc.
* Assist in testing and automate as required.
* Assist in system improvements including bug fixing.
* Make recommendations towards the development of new code or reuse of existing code, and improve/streamline processes and systems.
* Support projects through entire Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by participating in the requirements analysis and research gathering (R\&D) process, and/or writing documentation such as technical specifications and other forms of documentation.
* Follow software development methodologies and best practices


**Requirements:**

* Knowledge of VS Code or similar integrated development environment (IDE)
* Basic familiarity with GIT, Subversion, or similar version control systems.
* Basic understanding of Design Patterns and Object\-Oriented Concepts.
* Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, development, production deployment and maintenance; Experience or understanding of working in an Agile environment.
* Be able to demonstrate the required skills and experience equivalent to 6 months, either through an internship, previous employment, or in a college project.
* Experience or familiarity with C\# / Python, micro services, cloud development architectural patterns, MongoDB, PostGres, ReactJS is a definite PLUS.


**We’re on a Mission**
 In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance\-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
   

  

 Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end\-to\-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose\-built systems with world\-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.

 Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
   

  

 We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
   

  

 We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
   

  

 We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in\-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
   

  

 ValGenesis is an equal\-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best\-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for a
 **strong full\-stack Engineer who takes real ownership** 
 — someone who can take a feature from a Figma screen all the way to a deployed, production\-ready API and UI on a
 **Next.js \+ TypeScript** 
 front end backed by a
 **Node.js / Express \+ MongoDB** 
 API, with real\-time features, background jobs, and payments. We're not after someone who just closes tickets — we want a builder who thinks about edge cases, performance, and the user, writes clean code others can build on, and moves fast without leaving a mess behind. Whether you're fresh out of standout projects or have a couple of years under your belt, what matters is the quality of what you ship and how quickly you grow.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Build features
 **end to end** 
 — UI in
 **Next.js / React / TypeScript** 
 , APIs in
 **Node.js / Express** 
 , and data models in
 **MongoDB / Mongoose** 
 .
* Design and consume
 **REST APIs** 
 , handling auth, validation, pagination, and error states properly.
* Build polished, responsive UI with
 **Tailwind CSS \+ shadcn/Radix** 
 ,
 **React Hook Form \+ Zod** 
 , and clean state management (
 **Redux Toolkit / TanStack Query** 
 ).
* Work with
 **real\-time features** 
 (Socket.io),
 **caching/queues** 
 (Redis), and
 **background/scheduled jobs** 
 .
* Integrate third\-party services —
 **payments (Razorpay), email (AWS SES), notifications, file storage** 
 .
* Write
 **tests** 
 (Jest / Vitest \+ Testing Library) and care that your code holds up in production.
* Own features in production — debug across the stack, watch logs and errors, and keep performance and quality high.
* Think through trade\-offs, push back when something doesn't make sense, and help raise the bar on code quality.
* Collaborate with design, product, and other engineers — and ship regularly.



**What we're looking for** 



* **0–2 years** 
 building web apps (internships, standout personal/production projects, or freelance all count) — and a genuine
 **drive to build and ship** 
 .
* **Strong programming fundamentals** 
 — data structures, problem\-solving, and the ability to reason about why your code works, not just that it does.
* Strong
 **JavaScript / TypeScript** 
 — TypeScript is our default; you're comfortable with types, interfaces, and generics, not fighting them.
* Solid with
 **React** 
 (ideally
 **Next.js** 
 ) — components, hooks, state, and an eye for clean, reusable UI.
* Can build real backend APIs with
 **Node.js / Express** 
 — routing, middleware, auth, and sensible structure.
* Comfortable modeling and querying data —
 **MongoDB/Mongoose** 
 ideally (SQL fine), with awareness of indexes and performance.
* Solid grasp of
 **REST API design** 
 ,
 **authentication (JWT/sessions)** 
 , async patterns, and handling failure gracefully.
* Strong
 **Git** 
 workflow and a habit of writing clean, readable, well\-structured code.
* Able to take a feature from
 **concept to deployment on your own** 
 — and care that it actually holds up.

title: Web Developer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Villow is a modern home\-buying and property\-investment marketplace focused on Gurugram, designed to be transparent and free from spam. The platform offers a curated selection of verified, high\-quality homes and projects, avoiding cluttered listing feeds. Visitors can explore properties through immersive 3D renders, 360° virtual tours, and detailed video walkthroughs to make informed decisions before visiting in person. Villow also supports real estate investors with options for whole\-unit and fractional ownership, backed by clear market data, including micro\-market insights and government circle rates. A single dedicated team supports each buyer or investor, ensuring a streamlined, trustworthy experience.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Web Developer role based in Gurugram. The Web Developer will build and maintain responsive, user\-friendly web interfaces that showcase immersive property content and support smooth user journeys across browsing, shortlisting, and investing. Day\-to\-day tasks include developing front\-end and back\-end features, integrating APIs and data sources, optimizing performance, and ensuring cross\-browser and cross\-device compatibility. The role involves collaborating with designers, product managers, and content teams to implement new features, refine UI/UX, and troubleshoot issues in production environments. The Web Developer will also contribute to code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvements to Villow’s web architecture and security practices.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Web Development and Programming skills, with experience in modern frameworks and languages (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, or similar).
* Front\-End Development and Web Design skills, including responsive layout, accessibility, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Back\-End Web Development experience, such as building APIs, working with databases, and managing server\-side logic.
* Understanding of performance optimization, security best practices, and SEO\-friendly implementation for web applications.
* Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows.
* Ability to analyze requirements, solve technical problems, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in real estate, e\-commerce, or marketplace platforms is an advantage.

title: React JS Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and passionate React JS Engineer to join our growing development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining user\-facing features using React.js, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and an excellent user experience. You will work closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into high\-quality code.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop new user\-facing features using React.js and its ecosystem.
* Build reusable components and front\-end libraries for future use.
* Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into high\-quality code.
* Optimize components for maximum performance across a vast array of web\-capable devices and browsers.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to define, design, and ship new features.
* Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs.
* Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge.
* Identify and troubleshoot UI/UX problems and bugs.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and best practices in front\-end development, especially within the React ecosystem.
* Write unit and integration tests to ensure the robustness and reliability of the application.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, including ES6\+ syntax.
* Thorough understanding of React.js and its core principles.
* Experience with popular React.js workflows (such as Flux or Redux).
* Familiarity with modern front\-end build pipelines and tools (e.g., Webpack, Babel, npm/yarn).
* Experience with RESTful APIs.
* Knowledge of modern authorization mechanisms, such as JSON Web Token.
* Proficiency with HTML5 and CSS3\.
* Experience with responsive and adaptive design principles.
* Strong understanding of cross\-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them.
* Familiarity with version control tools, particularly Git.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with TypeScript.
* Familiarity with server\-side rendering (SSR) or static site generation (SSG) with React frameworks (e.g., Next.js, Gatsby).
* Knowledge of testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Enzyme).
* Experience with state management libraries other than Redux (e.g., Zustand, Recoil, Context API).
* Familiarity with UI component libraries (e.g., Material\-UI, Ant Design, Chakra UI).
* Understanding of accessibility best practices.
* Experience with agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About EdisonOS
 



 EdisonOS is a B2B SaaS platform built for training academies, schools, and tutoring businesses
 



 preparing students for standardized exams (SAT, ACT, AP, SHSAT, ISEE). We serve clients
 



 across the US, India, and Asia, from independent tutors to large school networks. The platform
 



 covers content delivery, assessments, student analytics, and third\-party integrations. It’s a
 



 serious product with real users and real engineering challenges.
 



 The Role
 



 Full\-time, on\-site in Coimbatore. You’ll work across the entire stack, building and shipping
 



 features end\-to\-end on a platform that serves students and educators daily.
 



 We’re a small team that moves fast. You’ll get context on what needs to be built and why. We
 



 trust our developers to figure out the how, make good technical calls, and ship with confidence.
 



 You’ll have real ownership over what you build, from design decisions all the way to production.
 



 What You’ll Do
 



 • Build and maintain features across our NextJS frontend and FastAPI backend
 



 • Work with PostgreSQL: write efficient queries, handle schema changes, work with
 



 JSONB structures
 



 • Integrate with third\-party platforms (SSO providers, external APIs, data feeds)
 



 • Debug and resolve production issues on your own
 



 • Make architectural calls at the feature level: data modelling, API design, UI state
 



 management
 



 • Write clean, readable code that your teammates can build on
 



 What We’re Looking For
 



 • 1\-2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and shipping web applications
 



 • Strong working knowledge of NextJS (App Router, server components, API routes) and
 



 React
 



 • Backend proficiency with FastAPI or equivalent Python web frameworks
 



 • Comfortable with PostgreSQL: writing queries, thinking about indexing, working with
 



 relational data
 



 • Familiarity with Shadcn/UI, Tailwind CSS, and component\-driven frontend development
 



 • Experience with Git, CI/CD basics, and deploying to production environments
 



 • Someone who has dealt with real production issues and knows how to work through
 



 them
 



 The Kind of Person Who Does Well Here
 



 • You take ownership. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see what needs to happen
 



 and you get moving.
 



 • You’re resourceful. You read docs, dig into source code, and work through problems
 



 before asking someone to walk you through it.
 



 • You communicate clearly, especially when you’re stuck, when timelines shift, or when
 



 you see a better way to do something.
 



 • You care about building things that work well, not just shipping something that looks
 



 done.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical
 



 experience.
 



 If you want to build product infrastructure used by schools and academies across the US and
 



 Asia, and you want real ownership over what you ship, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Human Resource - Mid Level
description:
Experienced and proactive
 **Senior Human Resources Executive** 
 to join our team. In this mid\-level role, you will bridge the gap between HR strategy and daily operations. You will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, resolving complex employee relations issues, driving performance management initiatives, and ensuring compliance with labor laws. The ideal candidate is a highly empathetic problem\-solver who can advise department heads while executing core HR processes seamlessly.
   

  

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**
* Act as the primary point of contact for employee grievances, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions.
* Design and execute employee engagement initiatives to foster a positive, inclusive, and high\-performance company culture.
* Conduct regular "pulse checks" and exit interviews, using the data to identify trends and recommend improvements to management.


**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding**
* Manage full\-cycle recruitment for mid\-to\-senior level roles, from drafting job descriptions to salary negotiations.
* Partner with hiring managers to forecast hiring needs and develop targeted sourcing strategies.
* Oversee the onboarding process, ensuring new hires experience a smooth integration into the company culture and operations.


**Performance Management**
* Drive the annual and bi\-annual performance appraisal cycles across assigned departments.
* Coach managers on delivering constructive feedback, developing performance improvement plans (PIPs), and recognizing top talent.
* Assist in identifying training needs and coordinating professional development programs.


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure all HR policies, handbooks, and procedures are up\-to\-date and compliant with local, state, and national labor laws.
* Collaborate with the finance team to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing, benefits administration, and leave management.
* Maintain and optimize the HRIS (Human Resources Information System), ensuring data integrity and generating monthly HR metrics reports (e.g., turnover rates, time\-to\-hire).


**PF \& ESI Management**
* 
+ Manage end\-to\-end monthly processing, generation of challans, and timely remittance of Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) and Employee State Insurance (ESI).
+ Handle employee KYC updates, UAN generation, passbook issues, and claim settlements/transfers directly on the EPFO and ESIC portals.


**Professional Tax (PT) \& Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)**
* 
+ Ensure accurate monthly/annual deductions, reporting, and statutory remittances for PT and LWF in strict adherence to Telangana state regulations.
+ Maintain and update official company details, establishment records, and business nature on central and state government compliance portals as organizational needs evolve.


**Audit \& Documentation**
* 
+ Maintain comprehensive statutory registers, records, and returns under various labor enactments (e.g., Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Gratuity Act).
+ Prepare data and serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external statutory audits or labor department inspections.


**Advisory \& Issue Resolution**
* 
+ Act as the first point of contact for employee queries regarding statutory deductions, UAN linkage, and tax\-saving declarations.
+ Track and communicate updates regarding new labor codes or amendments in state/central compliance requirements to leadership.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field. (A Master’s degree or HR certification like SHRM\-CP or HRCI is a strong plus).
* Experience: 5 to 8 years of progressive experience in an HR Generalist or HR Executive role.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* HR Tech: Proficiency with modern HRIS and ATS platforms (e.g., Workday, BambooHR, Greenhouse, or similar).
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact effectively with staff at all levels of the organization.
* Emotional Intelligence: High level of empathy and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyze HR metrics and translate data into actionable insights.
* Compliance: Strong working knowledge of local labor and employment laws.
* Technical Knowledge: Unrestricted, practical expertise in operating the Shram Suvidha, EPFO, ESIC, and state\-specific commercial tax/PT portals.
* Regional Expertise: Strong understanding of Telangana state\-specific compliance laws and filing frequencies.
* Skills: Exceptional attention to detail, proficiency in MS Excel, and the ability to manage strict monthly regulatory deadlines without supervision.

\- Develop and optimize firmware for features such as sensor integration, wireless communication (Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth), data logging, actuator control, and configurable operation.  
\- Create and refine custom PCB designs with focus on low BOM cost and easy manufacturing.  
\- Integrate various components (sensors, cameras, motors, power modules, etc.) into complete robotics/IoT systems.  
\- Implement power optimization techniques (deep sleep, battery/solar compatibility) for efficient, long\-running devices.  
\- Test, debug, and improve hardware reliability, including Wi\-Fi stability, environmental testing, and enclosure design.

\- ESP32 and Arduino platforms (programming, peripherals, Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth)  
\- Firmware development (Arduino IDE or ESP\-IDF)  
\- Basic electronics, soldering, prototyping, and troubleshooting  
\- Basic knowledge of PCB design tools (KiCad / EasyEDA) and component sourcing.  
\- Passion for building cheap, reliable, and practical hardware products from scratch.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills :**  
\- Experience with custom PCB fabrication services (JLCPCB/PCBWay) and cost optimization.  
\- Familiarity with sensors, motors, cameras, or other robotics components.  
\- Basic Python scripting for testing or automation.  
\- Knowledge of 3D printing or enclosure design for prototypes.

**What We Offer :**  
\- End\-to\-end ownership of hardware products right from Day 1\.  
\- Real exposure to production scaling (prototype → 100–1000\+ units).  
\- Competitive fresher salary \+ performance bonus.  
\- Fast learning curve in embedded hardware, robotics, and IoT product development.  
\- Flexible work environment with room to experiment and innovate.

**Job Purpose:** 
 The OT Cybersecurity Executive will be responsible for supporting and implementing cybersecurity measures to safeguard the organization's Operational Technology (OT) environments. This includes ensuring the security of industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, and other OT assets that manage critical infrastructure. The role will focus on identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, implementing best practices, and ensuring the security of OT systems against evolving cyber threats.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

**Operational Technology (OT) Security**
 Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems, including industrial control systems (ICS) and SCADA networks.
   

  

 Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on OT systems to identify security weaknesses and recommend improvements.
   

  

 Monitor OT networks and systems for signs of security breaches or anomalies, ensuring timely identification and mitigation of threats.
   

  

 Collaborate with OT engineering teams to ensure secure integration of OT systems with IT infrastructure while preserving operational continuity.
   

  

**Incident Response And Management**
 Respond to OT cybersecurity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate, resolve, and document security breaches or disruptions in OT systems.
   

  

 Investigate and perform root\-cause analysis for OT\-related cybersecurity incidents, ensuring quick recovery and restoration of services.
   

  

 Develop and implement incident response protocols specifically tailored to OT environments, including communication plans, reporting mechanisms, and escalation procedures.
   

  

**Collaboration With IT And OT Teams**
 Work closely with IT cybersecurity teams to ensure coordination between IT and OT environments and mitigate the risk of cross\-domain security breaches.
   

  

 Collaborate with OT engineers, operations teams, and vendors to implement security controls that do not interfere with the operation of critical systems.
   

  

 Promote awareness of cybersecurity best practices and provide guidance on securing OT systems.
   

  

**Vulnerability Management**
 Monitor and assess the security vulnerabilities of OT systems and coordinate patching, remediation, and mitigation efforts in line with operational needs.
   

  

 Conduct risk\-based prioritization of vulnerabilities within OT systems, considering the potential impact on operational continuity and safety.
   

  

**Security Monitoring And Threat Intelligence**

title: Lead Security Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 As a Lead Engineer, Security Signatures you will be part of a motivated engineering team that is responsible for the research, development, and delivery of vulnerability signatures. This opening is your opportunity to work on a unique security solution in the rapidly expanding fields of vulnerability management and cyber security is a company with excellent customer ratings and outstanding growth rates.

**📍 Onsite, Bangalore \| Full\-time (Fresher / max 1–2 yrs) OR Intern (3–6 months)** 




  





 We don't want someone who has only
 *read* 
 about drones. We want a builder\-pilot — someone who has soldered a power distribution board at 2 AM, crashed a quad, fixed it, re\-calibrated it, and flown it again by sunrise.
 



  





 At GiftdMinds (NASSCOM CoE\-recognised deep\-tech R\&D startup), you'll help build our RC plane \+ FPV head\-tracking platform, swarm drones, and VTOL systems — real airframes that fly, not slide decks.
 



  





 𝐍𝐨𝐧\-𝐧𝐞𝐠𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 (𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐞):

 ▪️ Hands\-on building of quadcopters / multirotors from the frame up.
 



 ▪️ Deep working knowledge of flight controllers (Pixhawk, SpeedyBee, Cube, etc.), ESCs, power distribution boards, and telemetry systems.
 



 ▪️ Drone calibration, tuning, and ground station setup (Mission Planner / QGroundControl).
 



 ▪️ Comfortable with ArduPilot / PX4 / Betaflight / INAV and MAVLink.
 



 ▪️ Experience with building and flying RC Planes (Aeromodelling)
 



  





 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐬 𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐢𝐭 𝐮𝐩 (𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫):
 



 ➕ 𝟑𝐃 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝐅𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝟑𝟔𝟎 \+ FDM 3D printing → UAV \+ Fusion is the perfect\-fit combo for this role.
 



 ➕ FPV experience (analog or digital, head\-tracking a bonus).
 



 ➕ Hands\-on VTOL / fixed\-wing / tilt\-rotor projects.
 



 ➕ Swarm coordination, autonomous / GPS\-denied navigation.
 



 ➕ Custom PCB design (KiCad / EasyEDA), BLDC/FOC, battery management.
 



 ➕ Competitive engineering club background — SAE Aero Design, IRoC\-U, AUV, Robocon, Mars Rover, Hyperloop, Formula Student, etc.

 Fresh graduates or engineers with at most 1–2 years of experience. 3rd/final\-year students welcome for a 3–6 month internship (convertible to full\-time). Electronics, Mechatronics, Aerospace, ECE, Mechanical — your branch matters less than what you've built and flown.

title: Scrum Master
description:
***hackajob**

 **Barclays**

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 Hyderabad

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented
 **UI/UX Designer** 
**experience** 
 to join our team in Hyderabad.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to take ownership of the complete design journey — from understanding product requirements and user needs to creating intuitive web and mobile experiences. You will work closely with product managers, stakeholders, and developers to ensure the final product is visually polished, user\-friendly, and aligned with the intended design vision.
   

  

 This role is best suited for someone who enjoys solving UX challenges, designing clean and modern interfaces, building interactive prototypes, and collaborating with development teams to bring designs to life.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**End\-to\-End Design Ownership**
* Understand product requirements, business goals, and stakeholder inputs.
* Translate requirements into clear user goals, user flows, and interface solutions.
* Create low\-fidelity and high\-fidelity wireframes for web and mobile applications.
* Design modern, visually balanced, and user\-friendly interfaces.
* Review implemented designs and support QA to ensure design accuracy during development.


**Mobile\-First UI Design**
* Design intuitive and responsive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.
* Follow platform guidelines such as Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design.
* Create adaptive layouts for mobile phones, tablets, and different screen sizes.
* Maintain usability, visual consistency, and accessibility across platforms.


**High\-Fidelity Visual Design**
* Design UI systems, screens, and reusable components using Figma or Adobe XD.
* Create visually rich layouts with strong design fundamentals, including typography, spacing, grids, color systems, and visual hierarchy.
* Use Adobe Photoshop for advanced visual assets, editing, masking, and compositing.
* Ensure all designs are clean, scalable, and development\-ready.


**Prototyping and Interaction Design**
* Build interactive prototypes to demonstrate user flows and screen transitions.
* Design micro\-interactions and motion concepts where required.
* Use tools such as Figma Advanced Prototyping, Framer, or similar platforms to validate design ideas.
* Present design concepts clearly to stakeholders and internal teams.


**Developer Collaboration**
* Prepare clear design specifications, assets, and handoff documentation for developers.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams to reduce implementation gaps.
* Support developers during the build phase by clarifying design behavior, spacing, responsiveness, and interaction details.
* Ensure the final product matches the intended design vision.


**Required Skills And Experience Design Tools**
* Strong proficiency in Figma or Adobe XD.
* Advanced knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, including non\-destructive editing, masking, compositing, and image enhancements.
* Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator is a plus.


**UX and Design Fundamentals**
* Strong understanding of wireframing, user flows, and information architecture.
* Good knowledge of usability principles and user\-centered design.
* Excellent visual design sense with attention to typography, spacing, color, layout, and consistency.
* Ability to create clean, structured, and intuitive user experiences.


**Mobile Design Awareness**
* Experience designing mobile application interfaces.
* Understanding of responsive and adaptive design across devices.
* Familiarity with mobile development frameworks such as Flutter or React Native is helpful.
* Ability to design keeping mobile usability, gestures, and platform patterns in mind.


**Prototyping and Motion**
* Ability to create clickable and interactive prototypes.
* Basic understanding of motion design and micro\-interactions.
* Exposure to tools such as Lottie, Adobe After Effects, or similar tools is an advantage.


**Technical Awareness**
* Basic knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3\.
* Understanding of responsive design principles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers and understand technical limitations.
* Experience in design handoff and developer collaboration.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience using AI\-assisted design tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or similar tools.
* Ability to blend modern UI design with cultural, traditional, or regional aesthetics.
* Exposure to scalable design systems, component libraries, and UI documentation.
* Interest in emerging design trends, AI tools, and product experience improvements.


**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

* Can think from both a user and business perspective.
* Has strong ownership of design quality from concept to implementation.
* Can create polished, modern, and practical UI designs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced product environment.
* Can collaborate well with developers, product teams, and stakeholders.
* Has a strong portfolio that demonstrates both UX thinking and visual design skills.

 Frontend

 ,
 **Next.js**

 Full Stack

* Work with
 **Node.js** 
 services

* Understand backend architecture
* Contribute across the entire product



 Because we believe great engineers aren't limited by job titles.
   




 Your playground
   

  

 Frontend

* Next.js
* TypeScript

* HTML5
* CSS3
* Tailwind CSS


 Backend
   

  

  

* Node.js
* REST APIs


 State Management
   

  

  

* Zustand \& TanStack Query

 Tools
   

  

  

* Git

* Postman
* VS Code


 Bonus Tech
   

  

  

* Docker
* Jest
* Cypress
* GitHub Actions
* CI/CD
* AI Integrations

 Someone who...
   




* Obsesses over great UI and user experience

title: AVP - Workday Product Owner
description:
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**


Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life\-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific.


Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi\-entity, multi\-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**


The Product Owner is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end\-to\-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands\-on domain mastery role. You are the subject\-matter expert, the decision\-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi\-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.


Revantage hires multiple Product Owners, each covering a cluster of related modules. Example ownership areas include: (1\) Core HCM, Onboarding \& Workday Help; (2\) Compensation \& Advanced Compensation; (3\) Recruiting, Paradox \& HiredScore; (4\) Talent \& Learning; (5\) US Benefits \& US Payroll; (6\) People Analytics \& Peakon. While specific module assignments may vary, the role profile, expectations, and seniority level are consistent across all Product Owner positions.


This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player\-manager who both delivers and develops.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Domain Ownership \& Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s) end\-to\-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI\-powered tools, third\-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement \& Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade\-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap \& Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo\-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi\-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt\-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands\-On Delivery**

* Remain hands\-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day\-to\-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem \& Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development (Future State)**

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5\+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands\-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi\-entity, multi\-PortCo, or shared\-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi\-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**MODULE\-SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE (BY ROLE)**


Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:

* **Core HCM, Onboarding \& Workday Help:** Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.
* **Compensation \& Advanced Compensation:** Salary structures, merit and bonus plans, compensation cycles, equity, allowances, and global pay practices.
* **Recruiting, Paradox \& HiredScore:** Recruiting business processes, offer management, candidate experience, AI screening tools, and sourcing integrations.
* **Talent \& Learning:** Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
* **US Benefits \& US Payroll:** Open enrollment, benefit plans, ACA compliance, payroll processing, tax configuration, and off\-cycle runs.
* **People Analytics \& Peakon:** Workday Prism Analytics, dashboards, engagement survey design, action planning, and People Analytics storytelling.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third\-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi\-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an energetic and organised HR \& Operations Associate to join our Pune office. This is a close\-to\-the\-leadership role – you will work directly within the CEO’s office, giving you broad visibility across people functions, operational performance, and strategic reporting. You will be equally comfortable managing campus recruitment and employee engagement as you are pulling together productivity dashboards and presenting data to leadership. If you thrive at the intersection of people, operations, and communication – and you have a flair for content and social media – this role is built for you.

**CEO’s Office Support \& Operational Reporting**

A significant part of this role involves working directly with the Founder \& Director to ensure leadership has timely, accurate visibility into team performance, project status, and operational health.

**Productivity Tracking \& Analysis**

* Own the tracking and analysis of employee timesheets on a weekly and monthly basis – flagging gaps, patterns, and concerns proactively.
* Prepare structured productivity reports across employees, teams, and projects – covering utilisation, output against targets, and time allocation.
* Identify productivity bottlenecks and present data\-backed observations to the CEO with recommended actions.
* Maintain and evolve internal productivity tracking tools and templates in coordination with team leads.

**Dashboarding \& Presentation Support**

* Build and maintain CEO\-facing dashboards covering key numbers across active projects, team performance, headcount, and HR metrics.
* Prepare crisp, well\-structured presentation decks for internal reviews, team meetings, and leadership briefings.
* Consolidate inputs from across teams and translate them into clean, visual summaries suitable for decision\-making.
* Support the CEO in preparing materials for client interactions, partner meetings, or internal communications where operational data is required.

**Performance Appraisal Support**

* Assist team leaders and managers in running structured performance appraisal cycles – coordinating timelines, templates, and submissions.
* Compile and organise appraisal inputs, track completion, and present consolidated performance summaries to the CEO.
* Maintain performance history records and flag individuals requiring attention, development support, or recognition.

**Training, Upskilling \& Development Planning**

* Identify training needs across the team through productivity data, appraisal inputs, and direct observation.
* Plan and coordinate internal training sessions covering time management, productivity habits, communication, and role\-specific skills.
* Track participation, outcomes, and post\-training improvement across individuals and teams.
* Build an annual training and upskilling calendar aligned to business priorities and team growth goals.

**Recruitment \& Campus Engagement**

* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for internship and entry\-level roles across Pune\-based colleges and universities.
* Build and manage a strong campus network – TPOs, student bodies, and academic institutions – to create a consistent pipeline of talent.
* Plan and execute internship programmes, from onboarding through structured learning outcomes and performance review.
* Develop and maintain a recruitment tracker and candidate database to support hiring velocity.

**Employee Engagement \& Development**

* Design and run employee engagement initiatives, team activities, and recognition programmes within the office.
* Coordinate onboarding for new joiners and interns, ensuring a structured and welcoming experience.
* Support a positive and motivated office culture through regular engagement touchpoints and feedback loops.

**HR Operations \& Policy Management**

* Maintain and enforce office policies, attendance systems, and internal rules in coordination with leadership.
* Support documentation, HR records management, and process improvements across the people function.
* Act as the first point of contact for day\-to\-day HR queries from team members and interns.

**Social Media \& Internal Employer Branding**

* Own QLB’s HR and culture presence on LinkedIn and other relevant platforms – consistent posting, community building, and follower engagement.
* Create content showcasing our HR practices, employee engagement activities, team culture, and internship programme highlights.
* Produce short\-form videos and reels for internal and external employer branding – basic video editing skills are essential.
